name: Pilgrimstrailen Kort
description: Pilgrimstrailen is a trail race in Varnhem organised by Varnhems IF, with start and finish at Varnhem Abbey Church. Pilgrimstrailen Kort is about 6.5 km, with quite a lot of climbing in the first 3 km and relatively easy running after that. The course runs through hilly, historic countryside where some sections can be wet and technical. The same day also offers Pilgrimstrailen Lång of about 17 km and a children's race of about 1.2 km around Klostersjön.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Varnhem Abbey Church
About 6.5 km with most of the climbing in the first 3 km
Two drink stations on the short course
additional: Timing is by chip, except in the children's race. Every finisher gets a medal. Running with a dog is not allowed because of narrow paths and sections of rough terrain.

name: Blodomloppet (Umeå)

price_tiers.distance: Promenad 5 km, löpning 5 km och 10 km

description: Blodomloppet in Umeå is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to participants of all ages and abilities, including children and teams, and ends with a shared picnic. It is a social and healthy activity that promotes community and wellbeing while supporting a good cause. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational running event, with a strong focus on blood donation and health.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in Umeå
The children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet
Shared picnic after the race
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at IFK Umeå’s club premises on 21–22 May and 24 May, and at Väven on 25 May. Teams of at least 5 people receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration changes are free of charge until 21 May; after that, changes require an in-person visit and cost SEK 50. An order ID is required to collect race bibs. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. The last day to register a team and receive the picnic bag offer is 18 May. Individual registration is stated to be available until 25 May.

name: Vårruset Jönköping
organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women, where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The event is all about the joy of movement and togetherness, with a great atmosphere among women. Everyone who crosses the finish line receives a medal and a goody bag, and teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. It’s a festive spring evening with entertainment and encouragement along the course and at the event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 5 km course
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken
additional: You can opt out of timing when registering, in which case your result will not be published in the results list. The recommended age is 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants are allowed when accompanied by an adult. Registration is binding and is open until one hour before the first start on race day. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal and a goody bag.

name: Blodomloppet Hudiksvall
organizer: Strands IF Friidrott i samarbete med GeBlod Gävleborg

tiers.description: 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 6 maj, 450 kr på loppdagen 26/5)

description: Blodomloppet in Hudiksvall is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or together with colleagues and friends. The event is part of Sweden’s largest fun run series, with a strong focus on health and social connection, and traditionally ends with a large picnic. Blodomloppet is open to everyone and promotes a healthy lifestyle while supporting youth activities in the organizing clubs.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km courses
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Water stations along the course
additional: The event offers discounted team registration and an Excel template for large groups. Changing facilities, toilets, storage, water stations and medical assistance are available on site. After the event, participants can enjoy a large picnic. The main races start at 18:30. The event is organized by Strands IF Friidrott together with GeBlod Gävleborg. Timed 5 km and 10 km races are available. Lilla Blodomloppet is available for children.

name: Vårruset Karlstad
organizer: Vårruset i samarbete med IF Göta Karlstad
description: Vårruset in Karlstad is a popular spring running event offering a lovely, friendly running experience for women of all ages. The race follows a 5 km course, with both timed and untimed participation options. After the finish, teams of five are treated to a picnic, creating a pleasant opportunity to socialize. The event area is located between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet, and the organizer encourages participants to travel to the start in an environmentally friendly way.
course_highlights: 5 km course, timed or untimed
Start and finish in the area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Bergvik in the days before the event and at the venue from 15:00 on race day. Race information is sent out about one week before the event. There is a supervised area where participants can leave their warm-up clothes before the start. The organizer recommends cycling or taking public transport to the event area. City buses are free upon presentation of a race bib or race information. Teams consist of 5 people and must be complete no later than one month before the event to receive picnic vouchers. Changing rooms are available at Sundsta Sports Hall. Teams registered with five people receive a picnic after the finish. Individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag, and a race bib.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp
description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is an annual fun run through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The race offers a 7-kilometre course with smooth, even surfaces, ideal for both runners and recreational participants. For a shorter challenge, there is AktivRundan, approximately 3.8 kilometres with no timing, and children can take part in XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan, a 1.7-kilometre route through an easy-to-run park setting. All participants receive a medal and energy products, and there are great prizes to be won. The race is open to everyone, whether they walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with smooth, even surfaces through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km without timing for walkers and joggers
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children through an easy-to-run park setting
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, 26 May, between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is available at the bib collection point and at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. Timing uses a chip on the race bib tab; without it, no time will be recorded. The children’s race has four start times between 17:00 and 18:00, depending on age group. All participants receive a medal, energy products and a water bottle sponsored by local businesses. The children’s race prize-giving takes place on the stage in Bruksparken at 18:15. The race’s official website currently provides information about the 2026 edition; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been specified.

description: Blodomloppet in Uppsala is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race is open to everyone, whether taking part alone or with colleagues and friends. There are also special races, including Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet, for different ages and abilities. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic and helps promote blood donation and youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is officially measured and runs through Uppsala
The 5 km and 2.5 km courses are popular but not officially measured
Option to participate as a team of 5
additional: Team registration for 5 people is available. An Excel template for large registrations can be downloaded. The 10 km course is officially measured, while the 5 km and 2.5 km distances are approximate. Dogs are welcome to participate. A shared picnic is offered after the race. Water stations are located along the course. Changing facilities and toilets are available. Medical services are on site. Race bibs are distributed before the start. The race highlights the importance of blood donation.

name: S:t Hans Extreme
description:
The course winds around S:t Hans Backar in Lund. In the ultra classes, the goal is to run as many laps as possible in 6 hours. The 10 km runners complete 4 laps and the 5 km runners complete 2 laps. Extreme One runners complete one lap.

One lap is 2.55 km with 140 metres of elevation gain. This means 10.2 km and 560 m of elevation gain for the 10 km, and 5.1 km and 280 m of elevation gain for the 5 km. Each lap in the ultra classes is extended with a flat section where runners go out and back along the same route so they can cheer each other on. The ultra-class lap is 4.38 km in total.
course_highlights: The course runs through S:t Hans Backar: technical trail with clear climbs and descents
One lap is 2.55 km with 140 m of elevation gain (10 km = ~10.2 km, 560 m of elevation gain; 5 km = ~5.1 km, 280 m of elevation gain)
The ultra lap is 4.38 km, including an out-and-back section where runners can cheer each other on; ultra-class runners complete as many laps as possible in 6 hours
additional:
The ultra starts at 14:00; the other classes start from 17:45.
Registration is at 
https://mittlopp.se/Anmalan/Arrangemangsgrupp/SHE2027_1

description: Blodomloppet in Örebro is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run with friends, family or colleagues. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, the Special Race and Little Blodomloppet for children. It is a social, healthy activity that also promotes team spirit and wellness, with the option to participate in teams of five. After the race, participants often gather for a shared picnic, and the event area is well equipped for an enjoyable day for the whole family.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses for women and men
Special Race: approximately 2.1 km
Little Blodomloppet: approximately 750 m or 2.1 km for children aged 1–12
additional: You can register individually or in a team of five, with the option to fill vacant places later. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA Stammis members (SEK 40), but not during late registration. There is no age limit for the 5 km and 10 km distances, but participants should be able to complete the course on their own or with an accompanying adult. Little Blodomloppet is for children aged 1–12, and adults may accompany them as long as they do not interfere with others. A large picnic is offered to participants after the race. Wellness allowances can be used when registering. The event takes place at Trängens IP. Participants receive, among other things, a T-shirt, race bib and medal; prices vary depending on the distance and registration date.

name: Vårruset
organizer: Marathongruppen, tillsammans med Hässelby SK, Spårvägens FK och lokal arrangör KFUM Örebro Friidrott
description: Vårruset in Örebro is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a measured course. The event is open to all ages. The recommended minimum age is 7 when accompanied by an adult for the shorter distance and 11 for the longer distance. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib, and can opt for timing on the 5 km course. Teams that register are invited to a group picnic after finishing, making for a lovely social spring evening at Gustavsviksbadet. The event is all about community and fun, with activities and a music quiz for participants.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Gustavsviksbadet
Water station and toilets in the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Marieberg in the days before the event. Teams of 5 can enjoy a picnic after finishing. The event area is at Gustavsvik Camping, where parking is limited; participants are encouraged to travel in an environmentally friendly way. Participants are advised to change at home. A water station and toilets are available on site. There is an option to leave a bag of warm-up clothes labelled with your name and race number. Race information will be emailed approximately two weeks before the event. Timing is available as an optional extra for the 5 km. The recommended minimum age for the 2.5 km is 11, or 7 when accompanied by an adult; for the 5 km, it is 13, or 11 when accompanied by an adult.

name: S:t Hans Extreme 10 km
description: S:t Hans Extreme is a trail race on the S:t Hans Backar hills in Lund on Thursday 27 May 2027. The course is a 2.55 km loop with about 140 m of climbing per lap, mostly on grass and worn paths. The Extreme class runs four laps with 560 m of climbing in total and starts at 18:30. The same evening also has Extreme Light over two laps and Extreme One over one lap, and a six-hour ultra runs in the afternoon.
course_highlights: 2.55 km loop with about 140 m of climbing per lap
Extreme: four laps and 560 m of climbing
Well-marked course with marshals out on the loop
additional: Entry is via Mittlopp. The regular fee until 17 May is SEK 280 for adults and SEK 180 for youths and juniors up to 20 and students. Late entry costs SEK 380 and SEK 280 and can also be done at the venue. Extreme Light starts at 18:00 and Extreme One at 17:45.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Eksjö Stadslopp is a community race that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The race takes runners through the beautiful wooden town of Eksjö and offers an enjoyable running experience filled with energy, camaraderie and joy. The proceeds go to Eksjö Södra IK’s children’s and youth activities, so taking part also supports a good cause. The start and finish are at Stora Torget in Eksjö, and the event has a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race passes through one of Sweden’s most beautiful wooden towns
The course is available in several distances, including 10 km and a 5 km fun run
Start and finish at Stora Torget in Eksjö
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Snäckan next to the swimming pool. Changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Start times vary by category, with children’s races starting from 18:00 onwards, the 10 km races for men and women starting at 19:30, and the 5 km fun run starting at 19:50. Group registration is available by email with invoicing. Results will be published on the club’s website after the race. The programme also includes a 1,000-metre youth race and a 600-metre children’s race.

name: Lindahls Night Run
description:
On May 28, we’re getting ready for another unforgettable early summer evening in Helsingborg. As the sun sets, the festivities begin at Gröningen, and we promise a magical evening along the Strandpromenaden by the beautiful Øresund, where you can choose to run 5 km or 10 km. Whether your goal is a seriously fast race and a new personal best, or simply a wonderful running experience with a big smile on your face.

Lindahls Night Run is all about joy—the city lights up, and community takes center stage. We hope to see you on May 28, 2027!
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with only 2 meters of elevation gain per lap
The course follows Helsingborg’s waterfront promenade, with sea views
The 10 km race consists of two laps, with the lap turnaround at Gröningen, where the crowd provides an extra boost of energy
additional:
Lindahls Night Run offers a course that is as straightforward as it is inviting—fast, rhythmic, and made for the joy of running and quick times. Starting and finishing at Gröningen, you run straight out along Helsingborg’s beautiful Strandpromenaden, where the sea, the horizon, and the city lights set the mood for the evening.
The course runs back and forth over an almost completely flat stretch. With only two meters of elevation gain per lap, you’ll have perfect conditions to find your rhythm, hold your pace, and enjoy the run. It’s a course for everyone—whether you’re chasing a new personal best or want to experience the feeling of running fast and relaxed in the evening light with your friends.

The 10 km race consists of two laps, with the lap turnaround at Gröningen, where the crowd, lights, and atmosphere provide an extra boost of energy before the final lap. It’s a spectator-friendly course that makes it easy to focus on the run—step by step, meter by meter.

Together, we’ll run into the night along the city by the sea.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: The adidas Shake Out Run is a 5 km race starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. It’s a perfect warm-up for participants running the Stockholm Marathon the following day, as well as an opportunity for other runners to experience the unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 people to register will receive an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size to run in, distributed at the event. After the race, people who register later can also collect T-shirts in the remaining sizes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance, starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
The race serves as a warm-up for the Stockholm Marathon
A unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: Age limit: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options include online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, and invoice via Klarna. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. The age limit is 13 years, or 11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Late registration can be completed online until one hour before the first start.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, officially measured in accordance with current rules, and follows a new route through central Stockholm. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, officially measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and the IAAF
A new route through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), with a passage through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, features mixed surfaces and has a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours, and the contact email for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The course passes through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
description: The loop is a real gem, if we may say so ourselves—a slice of Uppland at its best. The race hub is High Chaparral Park, with its large green spaces: a natural race base in the heart of the community of Vänge. Backyard Ultra Vänge will draw spectators along the course, which awaits you dressed in lovely spring attire. We have taken care to create a varied and somewhat challenging course. The result is an experience where something is always happening and the running never gets monotonous. Large parts of the race take place on the slightly bumpy trail on the outskirts of the community. You’ll feel as if you’re flying over soft ground beneath big trees and past colossal rocks. Several national-team runners began their running careers here, and many prominent floorball players have sweated through hard training sessions. An oasis in the forest—with a glimpse of Highway 72. A road tunnel takes you beneath the highway and into the unique Uppland rowing village of Vänge-Ekeby. The village, which has been a listed building since 1998, has medieval origins and a preserved village layout. Vänge Hembygdsförening has given the village an active cultural life and attracted many visitors. The course winds through this fantastic setting. Take the opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and a glimpse of society as it once was. Then it’s back beneath the highway and into the forest on small trails. Before you know it, you’re back in the community and looping around High Chaparral. Take a short rest and perhaps enjoy some of the energizing snacks on offer. Then you’re off again. Wonderful!

name: Skatås ryggar
location: IFK Göteborg Orienterings klubb-anläggning, Skatås, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Skatås Ryggar is Gothenburg’s largest trail race, offering a fantastic trail-running experience on winding paths in the nature reserves around Skatås, the Delsjö area and Knipeflågsbergen. The race has several distances to suit everyone, from youth categories to a challenging half marathon over five ridges. The start and finish are at IFK Göteborg Orienteering’s clubhouse, and the courses are clearly marked to provide a safe and enjoyable running experience in a wilderness setting. All participants receive a wooden medal and have access to aid stations and good food after the race.
course_highlights: The course crosses five, four or two ridges in the Skatås and Delsjö area nature reserves
The longest course is 21.1 km and includes challenging terrain with rock slabs and winding paths
There are aid stations at four locations along the longest course, with sports drink and water
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the event venue before the start. The timing chip is attached to the bib and must be worn throughout the race. A bag-drop service is available for car keys and other belongings. After the race, hot soup and bread are served to all participants, while homemade baked goods and drinks are available for purchase. Medical staff will be on site. Parking is available near the event area, and the nearest public transport stop is Töpelsgatan. The courses are marked with fluorescent red tape and clear arrows at junctions. Runners are responsible for following the correct course at junctions. The event venue is IFK Göteborg Orienteering’s clubhouse in Skatås. There are youth categories and a kids’ trail race, aid stations and food after the finish; parking is free.

name: Seskarö Trailrun 2026
location: Seskarö Havsbad & Camping, Seskarö, Haparanda Municipality, Sweden
distance_verbose: 12 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: Seskarö Trailrun 2026 is northern Sweden’s most fun race, offering courses for everyone, regardless of experience or age. It’s a competition and an experience for the whole family, with a focus on the joy of running. The courses wind through Seskarö’s fantastic trails and the beautiful natural surroundings of the Haparanda Archipelago, across varied terrain including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand. There are several distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 12 km for those looking for a bigger challenge on technical terrain.
course_highlights: The course follows existing trails and combinations of trails, with varied surfaces including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand
Technically challenging sections include jumping over logs and rocks, as well as sandy and cobblestone sections
Detailed course maps for 12 km (clockwise), 7 km (clockwise) and 3 km (counterclockwise) are available on site
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday 29/5 from 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 30/5 from 08:00 at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping. Bibs must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a Seskarö Trailrun finisher’s medal. Showers and toilets are available. Proceeds from the entry fee go towards maintaining and developing the Seskarö Trails recreation area. The race takes place at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping.

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club och Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra is a welcoming race in the deepest forests of Småland, featuring a scenic, hilly 6.7 km backyard loop and a 3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners. The event is organised by Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö, with a focus on community and charity; all proceeds go to charitable causes. The number of laps is limited to 15, creating a challenging but fun experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Hilly 6.7 km backyard loop through the forests of Småland
3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners
Nature-focused race with a charitable purpose
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 09:00 to Sunday at 00:00. The number of laps is limited to 15. All proceeds from the race go to charitable causes. Backyard laps start on the hour. 09:00; information about the 2027 start time is unavailable.

name: Blue Mountain Trail Run
price_range: 150-450 kr beroende på distans och anmälningstid

price_tiers.distance: 15 km - Alvars stig by Nordväggen AB
6 km - Östra Ånnabodasjön by ICA Glansen

description:
Blue Mountain TrailRun is a trail race in Kilsbergen, 20 kilometres west of Örebro. There are four courses of 6, 10, 15 and 21 km, all starting and finishing at First Camp Ånnaboda.

The courses follow Bergslagsleden and the MTB trails around Ånnaboda: narrow trails, roots and rocks, boardwalks over streams, moss-covered spruce forest and views of forest lakes. The 21 km Blankhult course has 527 metres of elevation gain and is the race’s long loop for those looking for technical trails and hills. The 15 km Alvars stig is the middle-distance course, with trails all the way. The 10 km Trolldalsvägen is the classic 10-kilometre course. The 6 km Östra Ånnabodasjön course goes around the lake on mostly easy-running trails and is suitable as a first trail race.

Men’s and women’s categories on all courses, no time limit, electronic timing and a medal for everyone who finishes. The runner who breaks the course record on the 21 km course receives SEK 5,000. The fifth edition takes place in 2027. The race has been organised by Garphyttans IF Orientering since 2023.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain along stage 9 of Bergslagsleden
Passes several forest lakes, including Norra Ånnabodasjön and Stora Dammsjön
Climb to Sånnabodahöjden, with sweeping views over Närkeslätten
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the race office from 09.00. Registration opens on 1 December 2026. The registration deadline is 22 May 2027. Late registration is available on race day from 09.00 to 09.15, subject to availability. Start times: 6 km at 09.43, 21 km at 10.00, 15 km at 10.35 and 10 km at 11.00. Aid stations with water, sports drink and snacks are located approximately every five kilometres. Trail shoes are recommended. Burgers, coffee and refreshments are available in the finish area. Swim in Södra Ånnabodasjön after the race. 21 km course records: 1:16:41 (men) and 1:29:16 (women).

name: Björkö Runt
description: Björkö Runt is a trail run of about 21 km around the whole island of Björkö in Gothenburg's northern archipelago, mostly on existing paths but also up hills and out onto rocks. It is not a race: runners stay together in pace groups. Start and finish are outside Restaurang Seaside in Björkö harbour. After the run there is an optional runners' lunch at Seaside, booked in advance.
course_highlights: About 21 km around the whole island
Not a race, running in pace groups
Energy station after about 10 km, where you can also join for a shorter run
additional: Sign-up is via the event on Björkö Trail's Facebook page. Marshals with first-aid kits run along, but participation is at your own risk. The ferry leaves from Lilla Varholmen and there is paid parking at the harbour.

name: Småland Adventure Race
description: A warm welcome to Småland Adventure Race 2027. After three fantastic years, we’re ready to take on a new challenge and aim for a race that’s at least as good as the last one. Småland Adventure Race is a multisport competition in which teams of 2–4 people use a map and compass to visit all checkpoints (CPs) as quickly as possible. CPs usually consist of a small physical orienteering marker and are marked with circles on the maps. The course will include a number of transition areas (TAs) where teams switch between disciplines. The race will mainly involve running, mountain biking and paddling, along with other adventures. In the three previous races, participants have paddled on air mattresses, climbed, tackled a high ropes course, gone SUPing and run a maze orienteering course. Some checkpoints have been at the top of climbing nets and others in the middle of a slackline, but most are in more accessible locations. We can promise many hours of wonderful adventure! We offer a long and a short class. Provisionally, teams in the long class will be out for 22–26 hours, and teams in the short class for 11–13 hours. In 2027, we’re also offering a Bike and Run class, a recreational class where you’ll be out for just 5–7 hours and take on a few fewer adventures—but still have a great time.

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
description: Markaryd Savings Bank Race is a well-organized running race in Markaryd, organized by SK Graal. The race has strong local roots, with Markaryd Savings Bank as its main sponsor, and offers an enjoyable running experience for participants of different ages and levels. SK Graal also offers training opportunities ahead of the race and supports the local running community. The event is a popular tradition that brings together runners from near and far.
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 until 30 minutes before the start. SK Graal offers training sessions on Mondays and Thursdays at 18:00. SK Graal members receive a 15% discount on running shoes at Team Sportia in Markaryd. Held in conjunction with Markaryd’s spring market.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
location: Långe Erik Lighthouse, Byxelkrok, Öland, Sweden
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon that starts at Långe Erik Lighthouse on Öland and offers three distances: 100 miles, 50 miles and 50 km. The race offers a fantastic running experience along the coast of the Kalmar Sound, through meadows and forests, and across the unique limestone pavement with views of the Baltic Sea. The finish location depends on the distance: 50 km in Djupvik, 50 miles in Lindby and 100 miles at Långe Jan Lighthouse. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and a T-shirt as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik Lighthouse and finish at Långe Jan for the 100-mile distance
Run along the coast of the Kalmar Sound and through meadows and forests
Views of the Baltic Sea and Öland’s unique limestone pavement
additional: All distances start together on Friday afternoon at 15:00 at Långe Erik Lighthouse. Aid stations or energy stations are located approximately every 20 km along the course. Get 15% off accommodation at Böda Sand during the weekend when booking with the code Lighthouse Challenge. Energy and hydration stations are located along the course; the official race website states that they are approximately 20 km apart. Published prices apply to 2026 and may change before 2027.

name: Säffle Stadslopp 2026
description: Säffle City Race is a community celebration in central Säffle, with races for all ages and fitness levels. Choose from a challenging yet manageable 10-kilometre race, a 5K run or walk, children’s races, or the exciting Boxen Race obstacle course. The start and finish are at Medborgarhuset, with spectator-friendly courses winding along the waters of the Byälven River and through the town centre. The event draws a large crowd and offers a wonderful atmosphere for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 10K and 5K courses along the waters of the Byälven River and through central Säffle
Mixed surface of asphalt and gravel
Boxen Race features varied terrain and obstacles on a 2.5 km loop
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on Thursday and Friday before the race at Team Sportia Säffle, and at the race office on race day. The start and finish are at Medborgarhuset, where refreshments, toilets and the awards ceremony are available. Boxen Race starts in waves in different groups. Parking is recommended along Billerudsgatan or at 45:ans köpcenter; alternatively, use public transport. Race categories include 10K Team Sportia Race, 5K Running, Sibyllapromenaden 5K, ST Loppet 1.5K, Papricaloppet 300 m and Boxen Race. Boxen Race is approximately 2.5 km per lap and consists of two laps. The minimum age is 15, except for younger participants accompanied by an adult competitor.

name: SPRIT FRONTYARD - TORUP (MALMÖ) 2026
description: SpriT Frontyard Torup is a frontyard race in the beech forest at Torup outside Malmö on 30 May 2027. The lap is 1 km of light trail and you run it as many times as you can, until the clock stops you. You have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9:40 for the second, and the limit shrinks with every lap. The course has a slightly technical path at the start and a 250 m climb after 600 m.
course_highlights: 1 km light-trail lap in beech forest
The time limit shrinks every lap
Start at 9:00 at the Kejsarvägen car park
additional: The entry fee is SEK 245 and places are limited. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap area. Entry is binding once paid.

name: Vårruset Sundsvall
description: Vårruset Sundsvall is a popular spring fun run held at Hamnträdgården, with the start and finish in central Sundsvall. The event offers two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km, with the course passing through the city centre and along Selångersån. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km distance and a great sense of community. Teams can take part, and participants are treated to a picnic after finishing. The event is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and is a perfect spring activity for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hamnträdgården in Sundsvall
The course passes through the city centre and along Selångersån
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km, with a certified 5 km course
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Birsta City in the days before the event. Teams of 5 people are treated to a picnic after finishing. You can opt out of timing when registering. There are no changing facilities at the venue, but there is a supervised area where you can leave warm-up clothes. Water stations and toilets are available at the event area. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. Teams consist of five people and receive a picnic after finishing.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ANMÄLNINGSAVGIFT 1750kr Lag (3-5 deltagare, picknickkasse ingår) fr.o.m. 8 maj

description: Blodomloppet in Borlänge is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to both individual participants and teams, with teams consisting of 3–5 people who can take part in different distances. The event ends with a shared picnic and offers an inclusive, social atmosphere for participants of all ages and abilities. Lilla Blodomloppet is a shorter race of approximately 800 metres for children, held in the area around the event grounds. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational running series, with a focus on health and blood donation.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km running routes head north across Sportfältet and split at Storsvängen
The walking route has no finish arch and ends at the fruit and medal tables
Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 800 metres long and takes place in the area around the event grounds
additional: You can register individually or as a team (3–5 participants). Team members can take part in different distances. Team participants receive a picnic bag. Late registration for teams is not possible after 21 May, but individuals can register late until 28 May at 12:00. Late registration on race day is available between 15:45 and 17:45, with payment via Swish. Name, category or distance changes can be made by 21 May at the latest by email or at bib collection on 26 May from 16:30 to 18:30. A simple kiosk offering Swish payments only is available at the event grounds. Water stations are located along the course. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and can choose different distances or categories. A picnic bag is included with team registration. Blood donors receive a SEK 40 discount per person. Entry prices and information for 2027 may be updated.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/borlange/): 2027-05-31 — "31 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-27)

name: Vårruset Östersund
location: Storsjön, north of Badhusparken, Östersund, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med lokala idrottsklubbar, däribland Trångsvikens IF
description: Vårruset in Östersund is a spring fun run offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km along the shore of Lake Storsjön, north of Badhusparken. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and offers a lovely spring evening with a post-finish picnic for teams. The start and finish are by Lake Storsjön, and the course is officially measured for 5 km. Participants receive a medal and a finish bag, and can enjoy a music quiz and prizes. They can also choose whether or not to have their time recorded.
course_highlights: The course follows the shore of Lake Storsjön, with the start and finish by the lake
The event area is north of Badhusparken, near Jamtli
The officially measured 5 km course also offers a 2.5 km distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Östersund on 23 and 30 May, 11:00–17:00. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members must register individually. Teams receive a picnic after the finish, which can be collected by presenting the picnic voucher on the team leader's race bib. The event area is easy to reach on foot, by bicycle, or by train to Västra station. There is a water station, portable toilets, and a facility at the information desk for checking in outerwear and valuables. The 5 km course is officially measured. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö SOK
description: Blodomloppet in Stockholm is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or in a team with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity and ends with a large picnic, offering a social and meaningful experience for all ages and levels. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, Specialomloppet, and the option to participate remotely.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in central Stockholm
Walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12
additional: Dogs are allowed in the 5 km walking category. Wheelchairs and walking poles are permitted only in the walking categories. Strollers are not allowed during the race, but are allowed in the event area. Team registration (at least 5 people) includes a picnic bag, with extra bags available to purchase. Tents can be rented for teams or companies in the event area. Start times are divided into several groups for the 5 km and 10 km, including walking and competitive categories, with prizes for the top 3 runners. Teams must register with five people. The walking categories are not timed; blood donors receive a discount. Information about the course route and start times for 2027 will be announced later.

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
location: Luleå University of Technology, Porsön, Luleå, Sweden
description: Vårruset in Luleå is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and offers a welcoming and inclusive running experience. The race is organised by Marathongruppen and takes place at scenic Porsön, by Luleå University of Technology. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a measured course. The event includes a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, a music quiz with prizes, and timing for the 5 km race. It concludes with a picnic for team participants.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Porsön, Luleå University of Technology
Water station and sponsor village at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Luleå in the days before the race, as well as at the event area on race day. Teams that register receive a picnic after the finish; it can be collected with the picnic voucher on the team leader’s race bib. Changing facilities are not available, but participants can leave their warm-up clothes in a bag marked with their name and race number. Toilets and water are available on site. The event area opens at 16:00, with a sponsor village and activities. Information about distances and the event format comes from Vårruset’s official website.

name: NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Nattmilen is a popular night race in Sundsvall, celebrating its fifth anniversary in 2027. The race offers timed 5 km and 10 km distances with a mass start, as well as an optional untimed distance. The race starts at 22:00 from Stora torget and has a festival atmosphere with music, energy and an after-run at Bloco restaurant. Nattmilen is an event for everyone, from beginners to experienced runners, and has become one of Sundsvall’s most eagerly awaited summer running evenings.
course_highlights: Run through Sundsvall’s beautiful stone city centre
Mass start and timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances
Sweden’s only finish area with a bar, since 2023
additional: Late registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start on race day, while places remain. Race bibs can be collected at Stadium City Sundsvall during race week or at the start area from 19:00 to 21:30 on race day. A water station along the course offers water and sports drink. After the race, participants are invited to an after-run at Bloco restaurant, with mingling and a party. Participants can choose to run an untimed distance of either 5 km or 10 km. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by an adult, or be at least 14 years old to run on their own. The organiser documents the event with photos and video that may be published; participants can opt out of appearing by contacting event@morron.se. The event is documented in photos and video. The stated race date is 4 June 2027.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
location: Kungsbergets skidanläggning, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon is a 65 km trail race through the scenic bear country of Gästrikland, starting and finishing at Kungsberget Ski Resort. The course mainly follows the Gästrikeleden Trail and offers fine, occasionally technical trail running, as well as some gravel roads. The race is organized by Björnfrossa Arrangörsförening and offers a challenging experience with approximately 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four aid stations along the way. For safety and communication, participants are advised to carry mandatory equipment such as a headlamp and mobile phone.
course_highlights: 65 km of trail running along the Gästrikeleden Trail
Occasionally technical trails and some gravel roads
Just over 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four staffed aid stations
additional: Race bibs are handed out in the start area and must be worn visibly throughout the race. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp and a mobile phone with the race management’s number saved. There is no drop-bag service; participants carry all their equipment from the start. Medical staff are available at the start/finish, but participants are responsible for themselves out on the course. The maximum time limit is 12 hours. Earlier race information also states that there are four staffed aid stations, the time limit is 12 hours, and a headlamp and mobile phone are mandatory; the race is not a sanctioned competition.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a popular 10 km race around Södermalm in Stockholm, known for its beautiful, fast course along the water with no uphill sections. The race attracts many runners looking to set a personal best and offers a flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel. After the finish, runners can enjoy a popular After Run party with music, mingling, food and drinks. The start and finish are at Tantolunden and Hornstulls strand, respectively, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: 10 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
No uphill sections; many runners set personal bests
additional: Water stations are available after 4 km and at the finish. Strollers and dogs are not allowed. All participants receive a medal and products at the finish. The minimum age is 14 for the race and 18 for the After Run. Payment is made via the website by card, Swish, invoice or bank giro/postgiro for larger groups. The start is provisionally scheduled for 19:45. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Minimum age: 14; strollers and dogs are not allowed.
