name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Convinistafetten is Sweden’s largest relay race, held annually in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm. Each team consists of five participants, each running 5 kilometres, and there is also a walking category where the team walks together. The event is a fun, energetic evening that promotes team building and company camaraderie. After the race, all teams are treated to a picnic with food, drinks, fruit and coffee on the grass. Convinistafetten has a long tradition dating back to 1986 and attracts over 3,000 teams every year.
course_highlights: Each team runs five legs of 5 km each
Start and finish by the transition zone in Stora Skuggan
A picnic with food and drinks is included after the race
additional: Relay teams start in three different waves, with the first start at approximately 17:30. The walking category starts at approximately 17:40. The team captain receives all the race bibs by mail. The final runner collects the picnic box from the picnic tent. It is possible to book extra picnic boxes and private tent packages to enhance the experience. Title sponsor Convini treats teams to a picnic after they finish.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Nattloppet in Kalmar is a unique running experience, inviting you to walk, jog or run 5 km in a wonderful atmosphere with music, lighting and surprises along the course. The start and finish are at Stortorget, where runners also pass through on each lap. All participants receive a special medal and, if they register in advance, a unique T-shirt, as well as a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate. The race is open to both men and women, and there is also a walking class without timing. The event is organised by Högby IF with support from Hagbloms and other sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km course with the start, lap point and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
Run at your own pace with music and lighting along the way
Special medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place at the Högby tent at Stortorget on Thursday 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and on Friday 21 August from 18:00. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Everyone registered by 16 August receives the Nattloppet’s unique T-shirt. Prizes are raffled, including gift cards from Kallskänken. Open to walkers, joggers and competitive runners. Everyone who finishes receives a medal; participants who register in advance also receive the race’s unique T-shirt.

name: Askes Fjällmaraton
location: Torget, Idre Fjäll, Idre, Älvdalen Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 kr som oavkortat går till Viggo Foundation

description: Askes Fjällmaraton is a child-friendly 1 km mountain marathon held on Friday evening at Idre Fjäll. The course is well marked and suitable for all children born in 2015 or later. There is no timing, but all participants receive a medal and a treat at the finish. You can register easily online or on site using Swish, and the entire entry fee goes directly to the Viggo Foundation, which supports neuro-adapted sports for children and young people.
course_highlights: 1 km course with clear markings
Start and finish at Torget, Idre Fjäll
Child-friendly race with no timing
additional: Registration is open online until 15 minutes before the start, or on site at bib collection using Swish. All proceeds go to the Viggo Foundation. After the race, every child receives a medal and a treat. There is also Fjällmaratonklubben for children aged 4–12, with fun activities on Saturday. All proceeds go directly to the Viggo Foundation.

name: Trailvasan
description: Trailvasan 10 is a 10 km evening race starting and finishing at the Vasaloppet finish line in central Mora. The course follows park roads along the Vasaloppet track towards Mora ski stadium and continues on paths and forest roads through deciduous woods along the Österdalälven river before returning through central Mora. The surface is 8 km of forest road and path and 2 km of asphalt. Runners finish under the historic portal reading I fäders spår för framtids segrar.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Vasaloppet finish line in Mora
Paths and forest roads along the Österdalälven river
Drink stations after 5.5 km and 8.3 km
additional: Mass start at 18:00, followed by open start until 18:15. The race is open from age 11 and has room for 1,000 participants. Bibs are collected in Mora on race day.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race starting in Berga by, Sälen, offering runners the classic Vasaloppet route through scenic summer landscapes. The race starts at dawn at 05:00 and follows the historic checkpoints to the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and traditional mountain farm settings. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status in 2026 and is part of Vasaloppstrippeln; the maximum number of participants is 2,500, and the minimum age is 17.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by—watch the sun rise over the marshes around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course, with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic stretches through open pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque traditional mountain farm settings
additional: Race bibs and chips can be collected in Mora or Sälen in the days before the race, or at the start venue. Start pens open at 04:30, and your time starts when you cross the start line. Baggage transport to Mora is available, and you can send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are refreshment stations approximately every five kilometres, as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum 2,500 participants; training grants of SEK 60,000 are awarded to the winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories. Ultravasan consists of two longer ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen–Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg–Mora, approximately 45 km). Both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a cross-country relay race held as a festival, where hundreds of teams made up of clubs, companies, families and groups of friends share the classic route from Sälen to Mora. It is the oldest event of the summer and offers a challenging course covering a total of 92 kilometres, divided into ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 kilometres. The race starts in Berga by in Sälen and welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners aged 8 and over. The entry fee includes bus transport for participants on the first two legs, and the organiser sends the team captain the race pack with bib numbers and information well in advance of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race between Sälen and Mora
Ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 km
Start in Berga by, Sälen, and finish in Mora
additional: The race pack with bib numbers and an information letter is sent to the team captain approximately two weeks before the race. The timing chip must be collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen between 06:30 and 08:00. A bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked, and runners on leg 2 must take the organiser's bus to Smågan. For legs 2 to 10, teams are responsible for their own transport to and from the changeover points.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vasaloppet.se/lopning/vasastafetten-lopning/): 2027-08-21 — "Vasastafetten 2027 Datum 21 augusti" (was estimated 2027-08-14)

name: Midnattsloppet Göteborg
description: Midnattsloppet Göteborg is a festive, high-energy night race that winds through the city’s lively streets and along Avenyn, starting and finishing at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The race offers two distances, 5.2 km and 10 km, giving participants a unique experience with music, spectators and the joy of running late into the evening. Midnattsloppet is more than just a race—it’s a celebration and a memorable experience that brings together runners of all ages and abilities. In addition to individual races, there are team and corporate competitions that encourage togetherness and the joy of being active.
course_highlights: Two-lap course through central Gothenburg and along Avenyn
Start and finish at Gustaf Adolfs torg
Festive atmosphere with music and spectators along the course
additional: Start times: the 10 km starts at 21:15, the 5.2 km starts at 22:54, the costume start for the 10 km is at 21:48 and for the 5.2 km at 23:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes from the last start group. At the 5 km lap point, runners arriving after 22:36 will not be allowed to continue for the second lap. A race pack and T-shirt are included with registration. You can use your wellness allowance through Benifex, Epassi and Benefits. Companies can purchase value codes for team and corporate competitions. The first start for the 10 km is at 21:15 and for the 5.2 km at 22:54. The 5.2 km entry fee includes, among other things, a T-shirt, timing, water along the course, refreshments after finishing and a digital diploma. A medal can be purchased separately.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://midnattsloppet.com/midnattsloppet-goteborg/): 2027-08-21 — "Datum: 21 augusti 2027 Distans: 10 km Första start: kl. 21.15" (was estimated 2027-09-04)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Datum: 21 augusti 2027 Distans: 10 km Första start: kl. 21.15

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultrarunning event in the scenic surroundings of Lill-Jansskogen in Stockholm, offering distances of 30, 50 and 100 miles. The race combines physical endurance with a sense of community in an intimate setting with a maximum of 100 participants. The course is an 11.8-kilometre loop with aid stations serving food and drinks at set times. Finishers cross the line both day and night, with generous time limits for each distance. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with good transport links and nearby facilities.
course_highlights: 11.8-kilometre loop in Lill-Jansskogen
Scenic surroundings with magical forest sections
Aid station serving food and drinks from Umara at set times
additional: Time limits are 32 hours for 100 miles, 16 hours for 50 miles and 9 hours for 30 miles. The 30-mile finish cutoff is 23:00 on Saturday, the 50-mile cutoff is 06:00, and the 100-mile cutoff is 17:00 on Sunday. The start and finish area has parking, toilets, tents, a restaurant, a 4-H farm and a café. Drinks are provided by Umara. Volunteer opportunities are available. The information states that the venue has parking and is close to the metro and buses.

name: Fjällvindenterrängen
description: Fjällvindenterrängen is a classic 10-kilometre mountain trail race from Laisaliden to Hemavan. The race takes you through beautiful mountain terrain along Drottningleden and finishes with a run through the ski area, crossing the finish line at the base station of Centrumliften. The race starts at 12:30 with a group warm-up and is limited to 200 participants to ensure a good experience. After the finish, energy, drinks and fruit are provided, and food and fika can be purchased at Anders Bistro. A family evening to get ready for the race is held the night before at Arena Hemavan.
course_highlights: 10 km of mountain terrain along Drottningleden
Crossing Mortsbäcken, followed by a steep, technical downhill section
The final stretch runs through the ski area, descending to the finish
additional: A bus to the start is included, departing at 11:30 from the Centrumhuset car park in Hemavan. There is a water station after approximately 5–6 km. Timing chips are handed out at the start and must be returned after the finish. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 13:30 in the finish area. Warm-up clothes can be left at the start to be transported to the finish. Toilets are available in Centrumhuset, but there are no showers. There is an outdoor toilet at the start. Start at 12:30 with a group warm-up. Limited to 200 participants; the entry fee includes bus transport to the start and energy at the finish.

name: Adolfsberg Frontyard
description: Adolfsberg Frontyard is a frontyard race in Adolfsberg, Örebro, listed in the Korskyrkan Örebro calendar. Runners complete 3 km laps, with 30 minutes for the first lap, 29 minutes for the second and so on. You run as many laps as you can manage in time. Past editions have had an open café where spectators can have coffee and cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: 3 km laps with one minute less for each lap
Run as many laps as you can manage
Café for spectators
additional: Past editions had the first start at 10:00, the second at 10:30 and the third at 10:59. More information is available from the organiser and on jogg.se.

name: Västerlösa Five Point Challenge
description: Västerlösa Five Point Challenge is a race in Västerlösa organised by Västerlösa Running Beer Club. Instead of running laps, participants run to five different checkpoints and collect a wristband at each, and the first to hang all five wristbands on their hook at HQ wins. Each runner chooses the order in which to collect the wristbands, but may only carry one wristband at a time. The full distance covers all checkpoints, about 10 km, and the half distance three checkpoints, about 4.5 km.
course_highlights: Five checkpoints, each with a wristband to collect
Choose your own order of checkpoints
Start and finish at HQ, the centre of the race
additional: The entry fee is SEK 200 for either distance. In 2026 HQ opened at 12:00 and the race briefing was at 13:45. The organisers hope to hold a new edition in late summer 2027.

name: Tough Viking
description: Tough Viking Kungl. Djurgården is a spectacular obstacle course race that takes you through Stockholm’s beautiful and historic surroundings. The course offers a varied mix of fast running sections, technical obstacles, strength challenges, and water elements. The race is spectator-friendly and suits both beginners and experienced OCR runners looking to combine speed, nature, and an authentic race atmosphere. The start and finish are located on Djurgårdsbrunnsvägen near the Maritime Museum, with a well-organized event area and services.
course_highlights: The course winds through the lush parks and historic landmarks of Royal Djurgården
Varied terrain with fast running sections and technical obstacles
Includes strength challenges and water elements
additional: Start times are selected during registration and sent by SMS before race day. Race bibs and timing chips are collected at the black Tough Viking tents by the Maritime Museum. The chip must be worn around the right ankle. A group warm-up is held 10 minutes before each start. Shoes with metal spikes are prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants can compete individually or in teams (at least four people per team). Bag storage is available on site. The Open class has a minimum age of 12; participants under 18 need a guardian’s signature. There are four hydration stations along the course. Missing obstacles results in five penalty laps. Parking is limited, and public transport is recommended; changing tents are available, but there are no showers.

name: Rinkebyloppet 2026
location: Ursvikssidan av gångbron, Rinkeby, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Rinkebyloppet is an annual running race that starts on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge in Rinkeby, crosses the bridge and follows Rinkeby Allé to the finish at Rinkeby Square. The race is a welcome tradition that also marks the start of the popular Rinkeby Festival. This year, there is also a class for participants with disabilities who use wheelchairs, following the same course and reaching the same finish as the other runners. Rinkebyloppet welcomes all runners and is part of the active and inclusive Rinkeby Run collaboration.
course_highlights: Start on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge
Run across the bridge and along Rinkeby Allé
Finish at Rinkeby Square, marking the start of the Rinkeby Festival
additional: A new wheelchair class for participants with disabilities follows the same course and has the same finish as the runners. A wheelchair class is offered on the same course, with the same finish as the runners.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
description: Stockholm Half Marathon is a popular 21,098-metre half marathon that runs through central Stockholm. The start and finish are located at Strömbron and Norrbron, in the heart of the city’s historic centre near the Royal Palace, the Parliament House and the Opera House. The course is easy to run and inspiring, taking runners past several of the city’s best-known buildings and neighbourhoods, including Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The first start is provisionally scheduled for 15:30. After finishing, runners can enjoy an after-run event in Kungsträdgården.
course_highlights: An easy-to-run course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Start and finish by the Royal Palace, the Parliament House and the Opera House
Passes several of Stockholm’s best-known buildings and historic sites
additional: Registration is binding and personal. Participants must be at least 17 years old (born in 2010 or earlier). Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish or invoice through Klarna. An after-run event is offered in Kungsträdgården after the race. After finishing, runners can enjoy an after-run event in Kungsträdgården. The official app offers live tracking, real-time results, maps and event information.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Östersunds SK och Blodcentralerna i Jämtland/Härjedalen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift Blodomloppet 5 eller 10 km: 350 kr (t.o.m 3 augusti).

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Blodomloppet 5 eller 10 km Ungdom (födda 2009 eller senare): 200 kr

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Blodomloppet 5 eller 10 km Ungdom (födda 2009 eller senare): 100 kr

description: Blodomloppet in Östersund is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or with colleagues and friends. The races start and finish in Badhusparken and offer a well-organised, inclusive atmosphere for all participants. After the race, participants often get together for a shared picnic, strengthening the sense of community. Blodomloppet is a recreational activity with an important purpose and a long tradition in Sweden.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are marked with red ribbons and signs
A lead cyclist shows the way, and course marshals are stationed along the route
Start and finish in Badhusparken
additional: Late registration is possible on race day via the website or in person at the information tent, with payment by Swish. The courses have been officially measured and approved by certified course measurers. The start and finish are in Badhusparken. Marshals and traffic guards are stationed along the course, and a lead cyclist shows the way. Participation is at your own risk, as no accident insurance is provided. By participating, you consent to the publication of photos from the event. The final date for team registration is 20 August; after that, picnic bags are available while supplies last. The start and finish for all races are in Badhusparken. The courses are marked and staffed by marshals and traffic guards. Registration information and fees for 2027 may be updated.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/ostersund/): 2027-08-23 — "23 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-23)

name: Blodomloppet (Sundsvall)
organizer: Sundsvalls Orienteringsklubb och Blodcentralerna i Västernorrland
description: Blodomloppet in Sundsvall is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event takes place at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, near the marina, and offers both individual and team starts. The courses are certified by the Swedish Athletics Federation and run counterclockwise along Selångersån, with scenic bridge crossings. Blodomloppet is a social, healthy activity that concludes with a group picnic for team participants.
course_highlights: Two certified adult courses: 5 km and 10 km
The courses run counterclockwise along Selångersån, crossing Sporthallsbron (5 km) and Montörsvägsbro (10 km)
Start and finish at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, near the marina
additional: Teams consist of 3–5 participants, with the option to add team members up to and including 18 August. A picnic bag for 5 people is included with team registration. Participants in the walking category may use poles or a stroller and bring a well-behaved dog on a short leash. Late registration for individual participants is available on race day from 15:30, at an increased fee, with payment by Swish. The courses are officially measured and certified by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Registration for 2027 has not yet opened. The race highlights blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/timra-sundsvall/): 2027-08-24 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 24 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2026-09-01)
New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/timra-sundsvall/): 2027-08-24 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 24 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-24)

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
price_range: 350–450 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100–150 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr) kallat ”Efteranmälan”

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr Lilla Blodomloppet Anmälan från 7/8 – 150 kr

description: Blodomloppet in Västerås is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12, with two shorter distances. The start and finish are at the Rocklunda area, with clearly marked courses and several marshals along the way. After the race, all participants receive a medal and a finish-line goody bag, and team participants are invited to a group picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area, on the football pitches north of the riding arena
The courses are marked with Blodomloppet course tape, with flag marshals at strategic locations
Lilla Blodomloppet for children features two distances of approximately 1,400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race offers a warm-up in front of the stage at approximately 17:00. Lilla Blodomloppet has two start times: approximately 17:15 for 1,400 m and approximately 17:25 for 500 m. Teams can consist of 3–5 participants and include a picnic for 5 people. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out, and there are water stations along the course. Registration is binding and cancellations are not accepted. Teams consist of 3–5 participants. The team fee covers five people and includes a picnic.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/vasteras/): 2027-08-25 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 25 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-25)

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis anmälan för alla barn och ungdomar.

description: NKPG City Norrköping City Race is a fast-paced and popular running race held in central Norrköping, starting and finishing on Olai Kyrkogata. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The course passes through classic surroundings, with packed spectator areas and more than ten music stations creating a fantastic atmosphere. The race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners in a festive atmosphere, with great prizes and a large crowd. There is also a free 1 km children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet, with a medal and goodie bag for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in central Norrköping
The course passes through classic Norrköping surroundings, with packed spectator areas
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
additional: Lilla Lundbergsloppet starts at 17:00 with four starts and is free for children. The children’s warm-up, led by Friskis & Svettis, begins at 16:40. The 10 km race starts at 18:30 and the 5 km race at 19:30, with a warm-up 15 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be collected at XXL Ingelsta on Wednesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 15:00 at the start and finish area. There are veteran, junior and youth categories, as well as team competitions for women, men and mixed teams. Water stations are located at 2 km and 7 km (Nodra), and at 3.5 km and 8.5 km (ICA Strömmen). After finishing, participants are offered freshly drilled water from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is chip-based, and results are published immediately after the finish. The ARQLY Sprint is a race within the race over the final 85 metres, with sprint prizes. 5 km and 10 km.

name: GKN-stafetten 2026 (del av Trollhättan Action Week)
description: The GKN Relay is a relay race held along the Trollhättan Canal during Trollhättan Action Week. Each team consists of four participants, each running 3 kilometres on a flat course around the canal. The event is full of team spirit and energy, with live music and an evening of fun and camaraderie. Participants can pick up their race bibs and relay baton the day before to avoid queues. After the race, there is an opportunity to enjoy a picnic and entertainment at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat course around the Trollhättan Canal
Team relay with 4 participants, 3 km per leg
Running combined with live music and a picnic at the finish
additional: Race bibs and the relay baton can be collected the day before at Odenhuset. NearYou offers a staffing pool to cover late withdrawals from teams. After the race, there is live music and the opportunity to picnic at the finish area. Race bibs and the relay baton can be collected the day before the race.

name: Höga Kusten Trail
description: Höga Kusten Trail is one of Sweden’s most popular adventure races, offering a weekend filled with spectacular nature, community and celebration in the High Coast World Heritage Site. The event features five unique distances over two days, with each course taking you across some of the High Coast’s most iconic and dramatic peaks. Combining running, jogging and fast hiking, the event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Alongside the races, there are cosy pre-event evenings, after-trail parties and a mini expo featuring equipment from leading outdoor brands. Höga Kusten Trail is more than just a race—it’s a complete experience in one of Sweden’s most beautiful settings.
course_highlights: Five unique distances over two days, ranging from 14 km to 60 km
Courses pass through the High Coast World Heritage Site and offer spectacular views and nature experiences
Aid stations and course marshals along the route, plus race briefings and an equipment expo before the races
additional: The races take place over two days, with five distances. On Friday, Three Peaks 18k and Coast to Summits 28k start; on Saturday, Twin Peaks 14k, The Original 45k and The Ultimate 60k start. There is a race briefing before each distance and after-trail parties in the evenings. Buses run from FriluftsByn to the start locations. There is also a mini expo featuring equipment from Icebug and Haglöfs. You can sell your entry through the participant group on Facebook, and optional insurance can be purchased through Startklar. Registration for 2027 opens Friday, 5 March at 15:00. Distance and programme details for 2027 may change; published prices apply to 2026.

name: Istrun
description: Istrun Half Marathon is a flat and fast course (approx. 70 m elevation gain), officially measured and approved by SFIF, offering ideal conditions for setting a half marathon personal best.

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place on 29 August 2026, with beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned to reduce the total elevation gain while retaining a varied profile with sections through nature, crowd support and several power zones; the marathon course finishes with a spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge. The race attracts international participants and also features shorter races and a MINI children’s race, as well as offers for businesses and tent packages in the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna, on a redesigned course with less elevation gain
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 aid stations along the course plus 1 in the start/finish area, an interactive map and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: up to five runners can be registered at a time; race bibs are not sent out. The marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and 12+1 aid stations. The organizer offers tent packages for businesses in the start/finish area and the option to use a wellness allowance. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes a team relay and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and aid stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a business village with tents in the start/finish area.

name: Stockholm Trail
description: Stockholm Trail is a trail race organised by OK Södertörn, offering a unique running experience in the beautiful Nackareservatet, just outside Stockholm City. The races follow winding forest trails and cross sunlit rock slabs, with courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with encouraging marshals and personal service. All proceeds from the race go directly to OK Södertörn’s activities.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely through nature, along technical forest trails and over beautiful rock slabs
Fantastic views and unique natural areas in Nackareservatet
Clearly marked courses with encouraging marshals along the way
additional: There are six different courses: 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K fun run (untimed), 2.5K kids, and Mini Trail for the very youngest participants. All participants receive a race bib with their name and a unique medal after completing the race. Showers and changing facilities are available at the venue. The course requires shoes with good grip and careful attention to roots and rocks. The 21K has a generous time limit to suit all runners.

name: Säve Trail Run
description:
Säve Trail Run 2027 

After a wonderful inaugural event in 2026, Säve Trail Run returns on 28 August 2027. We look forward to another day filled with the joy of running, community and wonderful nature experiences in Säve, north of Gothenburg. 

Säve Trail Run takes you through beautiful woodland, winding trails, soft pine-needle carpets and varied terrain. The route combines easy-running sections with technical features that give you that wonderful trail-running feel—whether you’re an experienced trail runner or trying it for the first time.

Choose the distance that suits you best: 12 km, 7 km or 2 km for children and beginners. 

The start and finish are at Säve Sportklubb, where runners, families and spectators gather for a day of exercise, joy and community.

All participants receive a medal to remember the event, and great prizes are promised for the podium finishers in each distance.

Säve Trail Run is for everyone. Whether you’re chasing a rush, want to challenge yourself or simply enjoy nature and the experience with others.

More information about Säve Trail Run 2027, including the race date, course profiles, maps and practical details, will be published on the website as it becomes available.

See you on 28 August 2027

images.alt_text: Flagga med Säve Trail Run-logotyp mot blå himmel och träd i bakgrunden
Löpare samlade vid startlinjen under en uppblåsbar båge på en löpartävling utomhus.

name: Midnattsloppet (Malmö)
description: Midnattsloppet Malmö is a festive, high-energy running experience taking place on 28 August 2027. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race starts late in the evening, creating a unique nighttime atmosphere in the heart of the city. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, with a carnival atmosphere, cheers from the crowd and music along the course. There is also the option to take part in costume races and corporate competitions, making Midnattsloppet a memorable and social experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The race runs through central Malmö’s streets in a festival-like atmosphere
Late-evening start times create a unique nighttime running experience
Music and activities along the course create a carnival atmosphere
additional: Costume races start at 21:12 for 10 km and 22:36 for 5 km. Corporate and team competitions are available to strengthen community and workplace wellbeing. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes, with a cutoff after 6.6 km at 22:27. Race packs, shirts and wellness allowances via Benifex, Epassi and Benefits are available. After the race, an After Run with wraps and drinks is offered at a hotel from 23:00 to 01:00. The 10 km starts from 21:00 and the 5 km from 22:30. Costume starts are available for both distances. A team competition is available for the 10 km and gives a discount of 50 kr per person. Race packs are collected at the chosen Stadium store; a medal can be purchased as an add-on.

name: Trelleborgsloppet
description: Trelleborgsloppet is a well-known city race in Sweden’s southernmost city, Trelleborg, with a measured course offering both 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walk or Nordic walk. The race starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken, providing a lovely, spectator-friendly setting. Trelleborgsloppet is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, and participants can enter team competitions and prize draws for an extra chance to win. The event is marked by a sense of community and fun, with a focus on making the race enjoyable for all participants.
course_highlights: Measured city course with gun time
Starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken
Course through an urban setting, with cultural landmarks and parks along the way
additional: Race bibs must be collected at Östervångsstadion no later than 45 minutes before the start, or the day before in the lobby of Söderslättshallen. Changing facilities are available at Söderslättshallen, with clothing transport to the finish. Timing uses a disposable chip (Neptron), and gun time is used. Late registration is available online until 45 minutes before the start and on site for an additional fee. A team competition is available, with extra prizes for groups of at least 8 participants. There is also a 5 km distance for walking and Nordic walking. Participants can compete individually or as part of a team.

name: Festivalloppet

late_fee.price: ordinarie anmälningsavgift + 60 kr för alla över 16 år

description: Festivalloppet is an annual running race organized in Strömsnäsbruk by SK Graal. The race offers an enjoyable competition setting for runners of different ages and ability levels, with the option to register late on race day. SK Graal is an active club that also offers training and membership benefits, such as discounts on running shoes. Festivalloppet is part of the club’s wide range of events and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The course runs along the River Lagan in Strömsnäsbruk.
Previous editions have offered distances of 10 km and 4.8 km.
Children’s and youth categories have been included in previous editions.
additional: Late registration is available on race day until one hour before each start. Payment can be made in cash or by Swish. There is no late registration fee for the youngest children, youth, or the walking class. Clubs registering more than 5 participants can email a registration list and will be invoiced afterward.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 16 augusti - 21 augusti (10.00/13.00) 695 SEK. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Rynningeviken Längre is a running race in Örebro that challenges participants to run as far as they can in three or six hours in the scenic Rynningeviken Nature Reserve. The course is a beautiful loop of approximately 2.4 km, mostly on gravel paths with a few bridges, close to the city centre. The event is a celebration of running, focusing on endurance and community, where participants can take on a unique challenge and aim for personal distance records. There is also a KidsRun for the youngest runners. The event is open to all ages and offers a wonderful day filled with the joy of running.
course_highlights: A 2,412.5-metre loop, mostly on gravel paths
Two bridges, with little elevation gain
Start/finish on cobblestones, with a shorter loop for the final 15–30 minutes
additional: Start times: 6-hour race starts at 11:00, 3-hour race starts at 14:00, KidsRun starts at 11:30. A mandatory race briefing takes place before each start. Timing is recorded using a transponder, which is loaned to participants and must be returned after the race. There is no timing for the KidsRun. At the finish, the distance is measured precisely using a measuring wheel. Water and energy supplies are available along the course, including sports drink, bars, fruit, coffee and more. Changing facilities and showers are not provided, but swimming is possible in the Svartån River. Toilets are available near the start area and after approximately 1 km on the loop. Participation is at your own risk. Group registration and discounts for young people and members of certain running clubs are available. The timed races are 3 and 6 hours long. The KidsRun is for children born in 2015 or later and covers either one full lap or a shorter 700-metre distance.

name: Kraftloppet Skellefteå Löpning 2026
description: Kraftloppet in Skellefteå is a celebration for both competitive recreational athletes and casual runners who want to challenge themselves in three different events: skiing, cycling and running. The running event offers distances of 21 km and 12 km, as well as children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m. Kraftloppet focuses on health and community, and offers the opportunity to complete a Kraftklassiker by taking part in all three events in the same calendar year.
course_highlights: Running distances of 21 km and 12 km, plus children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m
A recreational event with shorter and longer distances for different ages and abilities
Part of the Kraftklassiker, which includes skiing, cycling and running in the same year
additional: The Kraftklassiker rewards participants who complete Kraftloppet skiing, Kraftloppet cycling and Kraftloppet running in the same calendar year. Registration is available via links on the registration page. Contact Bergsbyns SK by phone at +46 (0)910-861 61 or by email at info@kraftloppet.com. It does not confirm the date of 28 August 2027.

name: Dundret Extreme Running
description: Dundret Extreme Running is a trail race held in Gällivare, starting and finishing at Hellnerstadion. The race offers three distances: 22 km, 10 km and 2 km, all featuring varied terrain and elevation changes that challenge runners of different levels. K22 is a demanding test with 800 metres of elevation gain and beautiful views towards Sarek and Kebnekaise, while K10 and K2 offer shorter but still challenging courses. The event is well organised, with safety measures, water stations, prizes for the fastest runners and raffle prizes for all participants.
course_highlights: K22: 22 km with 800 metres of elevation gain, a mix of trail and asphalt, highest point 823 metres above sea level
K10: 9.6 km with 240 metres of elevation gain, a mix of gravel and trail, turnaround point at Femmanvägen
K2: 2.1 km trail loop around Hellnerstadion with 60 metres of elevation gain, a fast and convenient distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Hellnerstadion from 08:00 to 09:30. All participants must cross the finish line or inform an official if they withdraw. Water stations along K22 and K10 provide water and Umara sports drink. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hellnerstadion. The prize ceremony takes place at 13:00 for K10 and K22, with a mountain prize for K22. All participants who finish K2 receive a medal. Live results and split times will be published via a link on race day. The registration page states that registration is through MittLopp.se and that race-day registration is not possible.

name: Godisjoggen 2026
description: Godisjoggen is a children's race in Bålsta that Bålsta IK has organised since 1995. Children aged 0 to 11 run a marked course from Gröna Dalens IP towards Bålsta centre and back, and in 2026 the course went through Bålsta centre, making it about 1.2 km long. At the finish the children get a diploma or medal, fruit, ice cream and a bag of sweets, and once everyone has finished the race ends with a shower of sweets. The race now opens the Håbo festival day and is capped at 1,500 participants.
course_highlights: Shower of sweets once all children have finished
The course runs through Bålsta centre
Prize draw on all bib numbers
additional: Family members are welcome to run with their child. Registration is via godisjoggen.se, and late entry at Gröna Dalens IP is possible if places remain. Registration for the next edition opens during 2027.

name: Kinnaloppet
description: Kinnaloppet is a friendly running event in Kinna, offering races for all ages, from children’s races to 5 km and 10 km in leafy woodland surroundings. The courses are slightly hilly and follow scenic trails near Kinnaströms Sportklubb. The day is all about community and fun, with medals for all participants and the chance to enjoy refreshments and food after the finish. There is a group warm-up before the start, and water stations along the course.
course_highlights: Races on scenic woodland trails near Kinnaströms Sportklubb
5 km and 10 km on slightly hilly courses
Water stations at approximately 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and the finish
additional: Late registration is available on site from 9:00 until one hour before the start. Race bibs and chips can be collected at the start from 9:00. The chip must be attached around the foot and returned at the finish; otherwise, the participant will be charged. Group warm-up takes place 15 minutes before the start. The 5 km and 10 km races finish at the same location; participants are asked to keep to the right so as not to obstruct runners in the longer-distance race. Refreshments, drinks and hamburgers/sausages are available to buy. Changing facilities and showers are available in KSK’s changing rooms. Papricaloppet is free for children up to 12 years old, and the youth race is free for 9–14-year-olds. Papricaloppet takes place in a child-friendly, car-free environment.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Sweden
description: Vikingatrailen is a trail race organized by Årsunda IF, starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The race offers several courses of varying lengths and terrain, including a 1 km mini race. The event has been well received, with many participants praising the organization. Participants can access maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles for the courses in advance. Vikingatrailen is a family-friendly running experience close to nature in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård)
Several courses: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Courses are available as GPX files and with elevation profiles
additional: The mini race starts 1 km from the finish, with bus transport to the start. Results and photos are published after the race. The courses are listed as public routes in Garmin Connect.

name: Blodomloppet (Borås)

description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a fun run that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children and a sociable atmosphere with team registration and a picnic bag. The course is hilly and passes through beautiful natural surroundings in the area around Ymergården, making the event both challenging and scenic. It is a popular wellness activity for individuals and teams, with a focus on community and health.
course_highlights: 5 km run/walk on walking-friendly trails in hilly terrain
10 km run on hilly trails and roads between Ymer and Kype, with a new route
Lilla Blodomloppet — a child-friendly course where children can run, skip or walk
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. An extra picnic bag can be purchased for 250 kr. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event until one hour before the start, for an increased fee. Names for race bibs must be submitted by 10 August. Late registration at the event area opens at 16:00. Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 700 metres for children up to 12 years old. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount.

description: Blodomloppet in Halmstad is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or together with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings participants together in teams and ends with a shared picnic. It combines exercise with an important social cause and has a long tradition in Sweden.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through scenic Tylösand
Lilla Blodomloppet for children and young people
Water stations along the course
additional: You can register individually up until race day, 1 September. Entries are sold only through the website. Tents can be rented for companies or teams at the finish area, which has sea views. Food, drinks and ice cream are available to buy at kiosks and food stalls by the start. Changing facilities, toilets and storage are available in the event area. The race is scheduled for 31 August 2027. Registration is not yet open, and the prices are preliminary.

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring for Culture is a cultural run through central Stockholm, bringing together artists, cultural workers and everyone interested to highlight the value of culture. The event is non-competitive and open to all; participants can run, walk, roll or dance along the route. It starts at Hakberget on Gärdet and finishes at the Swedish Parliament, covering approximately 3 km and passing central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made. During the run, the streets fill with music, dance, circus and other forms of cultural expression, creating a lively movement to make culture’s importance in everyday life visible.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km from Hakberget, Gärdet, to the Swedish Parliament
Passes central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made
The streets fill with music, dance, circus and other forms of cultural expression
additional: The start is by the Protest sculpture at Hakberget, Gärdet. The event is politically independent and aims to build a sense of community and highlight the value of culture in society. Information for 2026 states that the event starts on Gärdet and finishes at Gustav Adolfs torg.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: IFK Växjö Friidrott och Blodcentralerna i Kronoberg
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (uppgifter kan uppdateras inför 2027)
description: Blodomloppet in Växjö is a recreational event that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race starts and finishes in beautiful Linnéparken and offers a flat, fast course with plenty of spectator support along the way. There is also a shorter children’s and youth race, Lilla Blodomloppet, which follows a loop in the park. Blodomloppet is a social and health-promoting activity suited to both individual participants and teams, and it ends with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linnéparken, Växjö
Flat, fast 5 km course; the 10 km covers two laps
Separate 5 km walking route and Lilla Blodomloppet in the park
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum five participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Late registration is available at Linnéparken on event day. There is a separate 5 km walking category with its own course. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out on site. You can also take part with a dog in a dedicated dog category. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event area. There are water stations along the course. The event ends with a shared picnic for participants. You can register individually or in a team of up to five participants. The 5 km walking category follows a separate route.

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
location: Ramsviks Camping, Ramsvik, Sotenäs Municipality, Sweden
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail is a unique multi-stage trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Ramsvik in Bohuslän. Over three days, participants experience a total of 77 kilometres across varied terrain featuring massive cliffs, narrow forest trails, coastal communities and beautiful beaches. The race offers different start groups for walkers, joggers and runners, making it an experience for all levels. Alongside the race, there are activities for children at Kids Camp and accommodation options close to the sea at Race Village. It is a highlight for anyone looking to combine a challenge with spectacular nature and a sense of community.
course_highlights: 77 kilometres of trail over three days, in stages
Massive cliffs, narrow forest trails and beautiful beaches
Start groups for walkers, joggers and runners
additional: Participants use the Pace+ app for race tickets, start times, schedules and maps. The official accommodation partner is Ramsvik Stugby & Camping by the sea, where Race Village and post-finish activities are also located. During the race, Kids Camp offers activities for children such as sailing, fishing and a visit to Nordens Ark. Race Village is located at Ramsviks Camping. Accommodation is booked separately; Ramsvik offers accommodation packages with a cottage, breakfast and dinner. Kids Camp is available for children aged 6 and over.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description:
The HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon starts at Sundstorget, outside Dunkers Kulturhus. The unique route begins with two kilometres through Helsingborg’s historic and beautiful city centre. You’ll pass historic quarters such as Stortorget and the medieval fortress Kärnan, then continue through the Tågaborg and Maria Park neighbourhoods and the Pålsjö Forest Nature Reserve. The route then finishes through Laröd, down Tinkarpsbacken and along our beautiful seafront promenade, with the sparkling Öresund Strait before you.

The course has only 95 metres of elevation gain, with a hill up towards Kärnan after 2 kilometres and a long downhill towards the sea after 19 kilometres. Running the HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon lets you enjoy everything from the vibrant city centre to peaceful woodland and the sea.

At the finish, you can enjoy your achievement on the wooden deck—and perhaps celebrate with a dip in the Öresund Strait? Afterwards, head to our event area, with activities for the whole family, relatives and supporters.
additional:
START: 09:30, 09:33 & 09:36
DISTANCE: 21,097.5 metres
ELEVATION: 95 metres of elevation gain. 190 metres total (up & down)
SURFACE: approx. 99% asphalt, 1% other
HIGHLIGHTS: City centre, Bergaliden, Slottshagen, Kärnan, Mariastaden, Maria Park, Pålsjö Forest, Laröd, Tinkarsbacken & the Seafront Promenade
NEIGHBOURHOODS: City centre, Slottshöjden, Tågaborg S, Tågaborg N, Norr, Ringstorp, Mariastaden, Hittarp-Laröd
GPX: Available to download from the website.

name: Lydinge Resort Stafett
description: Lydinge Resort Stafett is a relay in Helsingborg where teams run either a half marathon or a marathon split into four legs. The start is on Sundstorget outside Dunkers Kulturhus. The 21 km relay follows the HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon course with changeovers at Pålsjö kiosk, in Pålsjö forest and above Tinkarpsbacken, and ends along the beach promenade towards the finish at Gröningen. The 42 km relay follows the Helsingborg Marathon course via Råå, Ättekulla, Fredriksdal and Pålsjö forest.
course_highlights: Four legs per team
Passes the medieval Kärnan tower
View over the Öresund from Ättekulla on the 42 km
additional: The 2027 edition is on 4 September with starts at 09:45 and 10:15. The entry fee is SEK 1,700 and there are 500 places. Classes are Men, Women, Mixed and Corporate.

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun is Gothenburg’s largest trail race, offering five challenging distances in beautiful and varied terrain close to the city. The races follow adventurous trails through lush forests and across rocky outcrops with fantastic views, combining technical sections with easy-to-run stretches. The start and finish are at historic Kvibergs Park, and the courses take you from the outskirts of the city into the wilderness, passing lakes and magical forests. After the finish, a welcoming AfterRun awaits, with food and energy to celebrate your achievement. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners looking for a true challenge in nature close to Gothenburg.
course_highlights: A mix of technical and easy-to-run trails through lush forests and across rocky outcrops
Passing idyllic lakes and magical forests, with historic stone cairns along the way
Start and finish at Kvibergs Park, with views over Gothenburg and the Säveå Valley
additional: The 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shared bus from Kviberg. Self-seeding in start groups takes place on site. Live tracking and split times are available. Mandatory equipment is required. Bib collection takes place on Friday and Saturday before the race. Public transport by tram and bus to Kviberg is recommended. Name changes are possible for a fee until 3 September. A children’s race is available as an additional activity. Most races start and finish at Kvibergs Park. The 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shared bus from Kviberg. The longer races require, among other things, a water container of at least 0.5 litres, energy supplies and a charged mobile phone.

name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
description: Västgötaloppet Trail is a challenging and scenic trail run through the forests and countryside around Dammen in Tvärred, just south of Ulricehamn. Participants can choose from three distances: 7 km, 17 km and 27 km, all starting and finishing in the same beautiful area. The course features narrow forest trails, moss-covered rocky sections and magical views over Åsunden, making the race an adventure full of camaraderie and the joy of running. Hot food is served after the finish, and all participants receive a medal. There is also a free mini race for the youngest runners, with an emphasis on fun and enjoyment.
course_highlights: Narrow forest trails and hilly terrain
Moss-covered rocky sections and exposed bedrock
Beautiful views over Åsunden
additional: All distances start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred. Parking is available nearby. Food and drinks, great music and sun loungers are available on site. Race officials and an announcer help spectators follow the race highlights. Hot food is included for all participants after the finish. The free mini race for children starts at 10:45, with on-site registration. Maximum 300 participants. The entry fee is the same for all distances. Reduced fees for children and young people.

name: Årsta Gravel Run
organizer: Adam Widén, Stockholms Simfestival och CHPO Brand
description: Årsta Gravel Run is an 8 km race combining trail, gravel and city running around the Årsta forest in Stockholm. It is part of Dockside Swim & Gravel Run and runs alongside a 1,500 m open water swim along Liljeholmskajen, finishing at the same quay. You cannot both run and swim, but you can compete as a team where one swims and one runs and the times are added together. After the races there is a joint party in Plåtparken.
course_highlights: 8 km of trail, gravel and city around the Årsta forest
Finish at Liljeholmskajen
After-party in Plåtparken next to the finish
additional: Dockside Swim & Gravel Run is organised by Adam Widén, Stockholms Simfestival and CHPO Brand, with volunteers mainly from Zinken Löpklubb and Simklubben Neptun. The entry fee includes chip timing, a beer or alcohol-free drink in Plåtparken and a pair of sunglasses. In 2026 the races started at 15:00.

name: Enskede Backyard Kvarterslopp 2026
description: Enskede Backyard Kvarterslopp is a backyard race in the neighbourhood around Fågelkärrskroken in Enskede where the most laps wins. Runners choose between two loops, 4.5 km or 6.7 km, and run as many laps as they want and can manage. The course is available as a GPX file in the Enskede Backyard Strava group. The organisers have announced that the race returns in 2027.
course_highlights: Two loops to choose from, 4.5 km and 6.7 km
Most laps wins
Start and finish at Fågelkärrskroken in Enskede
additional: The date and registration for 2027 have not been published yet. The organisers post updates on Instagram.

name: Billingen X-trail Challenge
description: Billingen X-Trail Challenge is a trail race on Billingen in Skövde where runners choose between 5 km and 15 km in scenic and varied terrain. It suits both first-time trail runners and those who want to challenge themselves, and you can run, jog or walk at your own pace. The race centre is at the top of the Billingen ski slope, close to the start at Billingecenter. There is one energy station on the course and one in the finish area.
course_highlights: Trails and hills on Billingen
Two distances: 5 km and 15 km
Showers and changing rooms at Billingecenter by the start
additional: In 2026 the 15 km started at 10:00 and the 5 km at 10:30. You must be at least 16 for the 15 km and at least 12 for the 5 km. Registration is via Race-ID, and on-site entry is possible at bib collection on race day.

name: 3ST - 3 SJÖAR TRAIL
description: 3ST - 3 Sjöar Trail is a trail race in Sövde starting and finishing at the beach, held as part of the Sjöfestivalen lake festival. The 5 km is an easy trail course suitable for all ages and levels, while the 15 km is more demanding but still accessible to everyone, with some more technical sections. There is also a 5 km walking class. The course is well marked and electronically timed.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the beach in Sövde
Staffed food and drink station on the 15 km
Poles are not allowed
additional: The entry fee is listed as SEK 150-195 / 330 and places are limited. Registration is via Sportstiming and is binding once paid. In 2026 the 15 km started at 10:15, the 5 km at 10:30 and the walking class at 10:35. Children and young people get a medal and everyone gets a finisher gift.

name: Lasse-Majaloppet
description: Lasse-Majaloppet is a cross-country ski race organised by Arboga Ski Club, with three distances: 23 km, 13 km and 6 km. The race offers a great opportunity to ski through varied terrain and is a traditional event in Arboga. It welcomes both recreational and competitive skiers.
course_highlights: Three distances: 23 km, 13 km and 6 km
Varied terrain in Arboga
Organised by Arboga Ski Club
additional: The race has been held since the mid-1970s.

name: Mössebergslunken
description: Mössebergslunken is a classic running race in Falköping, organised by IK Wilske. For over 50 years, the race has brought together competitive runners and recreational runners, and takes place on Mösseberg. The course has changed over the years, and a new course was unveiled in 2022. Welcome to a race steeped in tradition in the Mösseberg area.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Mösseberg in Falköping.
The course has changed over the years; a new course was unveiled ahead of the 2022 race.
A race steeped in tradition, with over 50 years of history.

name: Helsingborg Marathon
description:
The Helsingborg Marathon was created with a clear goal—to showcase the very best of our city. Starting at Sundstorget, with Dunkers Kulturhus as its backdrop, the course heads south on a flat, fast opening along the sea towards Råå marina and then onwards to Ättekulla Nature Reserve.

From there, two of the city’s most popular natural attractions await—Ramlösa Brunnspark and Jordbodalen—before the course takes you straight into a unique setting: Fredriksdal Museums and Gardens. Here you literally run through a farm in the middle of the city, before the contrasts reach their peak at Helsingborg Arena and the classic Olympia stadium.

In the second half of the race, you’ll encounter historic Kärnan, the tranquillity of Pålsjö Forest and the historic neighbourhoods around Maria Park, followed by fast-running Laröd. Then you can let loose downhill on Tinkarpsbacken and make your way towards the sea.

The final 3,000 metres are something special. Every hundred metres is marked in a countdown towards the finish at Gröningen. Along the finishing straight, you’ll be met by a sea of flags, the breeze from Öresund and a feeling that only Helsingborg can give you.

At the finish, the wooden deck and celebrations by the water await. A course full of variety, experiences and energy—and afterwards, everyone feels the same: I’ll do this again next year!
additional:
DISTANCE: 42,195 metres
ELEVATION: Total climb of 135 metres. 270 metres in total (up & down)
SURFACE: approx. 89% asphalt, 10% packed gravel, 1% other
HIGHLIGHTS: City, Råå harbour, Ramlösa Brunnspark, Jordbodalen, Fredriksdal, Kärnan, Maria Park, Pålsjö Forest, Laröd, the promenade
DISTRICTS: Centrum, Söder, Planteringen, Miatorp, Högasten, Råå, Ättekulla, Ramlösa, Elineberg, Närlunda, Fältabacken, Wilson Park, Eneborg, Olympia, Slottshöjden, Tågaborg S, Tågaborg N, Norr, Ringstorp, Mariastaden, Hittarp-Laröd
GPX: Available to download from the website

name: Hålahult Blackwood Manor TrailRun
description: Hålahult Blackwood Manor TrailRun is a trail race starting and finishing at the former Hålahult sanatorium at the foot of Kilsbergen, 20 km north of Örebro. It is organised by Trailmakaren together with Almby IK and has two courses, 17 km Amboberget with about 400 metres of climbing and 7 km Falleraberget. The trails run between Falleraberget, Hålaberget and Amboberget with views over the Närke plain. The organiser has announced the next edition for Sunday 5 September 2027.
course_highlights: Start across the old stone bridge Suckarnas bro
Views from the Amboberget cliffs and over the Närke plain
360-degree panorama from Hålaberget
additional: The 17 km course has an energy station at about 9 km, and drinks and energy are available at the finish for both courses. After the race runners gather at the Hålahult café. Entries are binding but can be transferred to someone else through the organiser. In 2026 the 17 km cost 350-400 SEK and the 7 km 300-350 SEK depending on the entry date.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic route along the riverside promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km routes along the riverside promenade and city streets
Officially measured 5,000 m course by an SFIF course measurer
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams of 3–5 participants, with a picnic for 5 people included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter routes within the park. The course is officially measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old; Specialomloppet is 1.5–3 km.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual town race through beautiful Skärblacka in Östergötland. The event offers a festival atmosphere where everyone can take part, whether they choose to run 6 km, walk 4 km or cheer from the sidelines. The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partly on trails, with the start and finish at Folkets Hus. There are great prizes and exciting features such as the Mericon sprint and prize ceremonies for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: 6 km run through Skärblacka on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and trails
4 km walking class without timekeeping, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
Mericon sprint over the final 300 metres, with a chance to win a gift card
additional: Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on the Tuesday before the race between 11:00 and 18:00, or at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is available at race-number collection and on race day for an additional fee. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, gift cards are available for the Mericon sprint, and there are also prizes for picking up trimmers and tyres along the course. The walking class is not timed, and dogs are not allowed. A first-aid volunteer will be on site. There is also a 4 km walking class.

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a running event offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most biologically diverse regions. The races range from 8 km to 100 miles and cover a mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities and offers a memorable weekend in Nävekvarn, surrounded by beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Distances ranging from 8 km to 100 miles
Beautiful, biologically diverse region along the Sörmlandsleden trail
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. After the race, a sauna and Nävekvarn Folkets Park are available. Well-stocked aid stations offer, among other things, Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, and locally produced food. GPS tracking and live results are available. Mandatory equipment requirements vary by distance and include a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, and a headlamp for longer distances. Transport from the finish is available for the 50 km distance, with a bus to Nyköping Central Station. Race weekend runs from 10–12 September 2027. Registration opens on 1 December.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is an ultramarathon offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most species-rich regions. The race offers several distances from 8 km up to 100 miles, across varied terrain including forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and levels and promises a memorable day in beautiful and challenging natural surroundings. After the race, sauna and locally produced food and drinks are available at Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Beautiful and challenging trail sections on the Sörmlandsleden trail
Well-stocked aid stations with a variety of energy options and drinks
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS tracker, a mobile phone with important numbers, a first-aid kit, a rain jacket, and a headlamp with extra batteries. Well-stocked aid stations along the course offer Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, fruit, chips, and local specialties, among other items. After the race, sauna, locally produced food, and non-alcoholic beer are available. Shuttle buses from the finish of the 50 km race to Nyköping Central Station are available.

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultramarathon; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many small, steep hills and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and that a large part of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultramarathon (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many small hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp in a tent on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire, BBQ and pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp each lap; there are special elements for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products, and support to help find a running buddy for laps in the dark. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate through the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a highly regarded race organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The race offers a varied course combining asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails through scenic, gently rolling terrain around Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg. The start and finish are at Edbergavallen, and the event offers several distances for both children and adults, with timing for most races. It is a family-friendly and inclusive competition, with medals for everyone who finishes and special commemorative medals for loyal participants.
course_highlights: A varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails
Scenic terrain around Lake Bysjön with moderate elevation changes
The 10 km course includes challenging trail sections and floodlit trails
additional: Start times: 700 m at 11:30, 1.3 km at 11:40, and 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at Kanonvallen. A kiosk serving hot dogs, drinks and sweets is located at the event venue. Teams consist of 4–6 participants in any categories and receive a picnic bag from ICA Supermarket to share after finishing. Late registration is available on site from 10:00, with payment by Swish or cash; discount codes cannot be used for on-site late registration. The race has traditionally been held on the second Saturday in September and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a classic half marathon in Nora with a long tradition dating back to 1929. The course goes around Lake Norasjön and offers varied scenery, including forests, open fields and sections crossing streams. The race welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Half marathon course around Lake Norasjön
Varied scenery with forests and open fields
Sections crossing streams
additional: The race has been held since 1929.

name: Hagenloppet
description: Hagenloppet is a traditional running race held at Billingen in Skövde. The race offers several distances, including 8.8 km, 4.4 km, 2.5 km, and a children’s race for the youngest participants. The spectator-friendly course consists of two loops, with the start and finish at the ski stadium. The event is marked by a wonderful spirit of running and has a long history, attracting many participants from different age groups.
course_highlights: The course is 4.4 km long and consists of two loops
Start and finish at the ski stadium on Billingen
Spectator-friendly course with clear markings and course marshals
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the ski stadium from 10:00 and no later than 30 minutes before the start. Timing is done with a chip attached to the race number. Water is available at the lap point and finish. All finishers receive a medal. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in different categories. Late registration is available on race day from 10:00 until 45 minutes before the start. Refreshments are available near the finish. Parking is at the main car park in the Billingen Recreation Area.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a recreational race offering a unique nature experience and challenge across three distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The race features varied terrain, from asphalt to winding trails through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget. The start and finish are centrally located at Gränna Square, where participants can enjoy beautiful views of Lake Vättern and a mass start. All participants receive a unique medal, and all distances are timed. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners who want to combine performance with a nature experience.
course_highlights: 21 km course combining asphalt, trails and gravel roads
Route through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget
Start and finish at Gränna Square, with views over Lake Vättern
additional: Mass start from Gränna Square, through town to the harbor, where timing begins. The event arena is in the center of Gränna, close to shops, cafés and accommodation. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits. Timing and a medal at the finish.

name: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra
location: Ästad Vingård, Tvååker, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra is a unique trail race held at Ästad Vingård. The race follows a 6.7 km loop through beautiful surroundings, with a start every hour on the hour. Participants run lap after lap until only one runner remains, creating an exciting and challenging race format. The event offers a wonderful atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy Ästad Vingård’s scenic surroundings over an entire weekend.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the beautiful surroundings of Ästad Vingård
A start every hour on the hour, with runners completing laps until only one remains
Scenic views of beech forests, spruce forests and bogs
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00. Anyone who does not complete the course before the next start is out of the race. The race continues until only one participant remains, and that runner completes a final solo lap. The loop course increases safety, makes the race spectator-friendly and allows runners to change equipment at the end of each lap. The event encourages community and respect for nature. The first start is at 09:00. The race continues until one participant remains, and that runner completes a final lap.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a trail race in the beautiful and rugged Paradiset Nature Reserve in southern Stockholm. The race offers challenging trail running along winding paths, across marshes and boardwalks, where runners experience forest, mountains and sea. Distances are 26 km, 13 km and 6 km, and the 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour. The race is marked by a strong sense of community and a festive atmosphere after the finish.
course_highlights: Beautiful, wild terrain with rocky outcrops and open pine forest
Small winding paths, marshes and boardwalks
The 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race offers three distances: 26 km, 13 km and 6 km. The terrain is challenging and gives a strong sense of achievement. 26 km. The race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Södra änggårdsloppet
description: Södra Änggårdsloppet is an 8 km trail race with 310 metres of elevation gain through the scenic surroundings of Änggårdsbergen. For the third year in a row, the organisers are inviting runners to a celebration, with a course suited to both competitive runners and recreational runners thanks to staggered start groups. The event offers a festive atmosphere with smoke fireworks, food trucks, a DJ, and activities for family and friends. Participants receive a fine medal, sparkling wine at check-in, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. The race is organised by WAI AB and is an opportunity for both runners and spectators to enjoy trail running in the Gothenburg area.
course_highlights: 8 km trail race with 310 metres of elevation gain
The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Änggårdsbergen
The field is divided into groups for both competitive and recreational runners
