additional: The field is divided into groups to create a comfortable experience for both competitive and recreational runners. Sparkling wine is available at check-in and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. The event includes smoke fireworks, food trucks, and a DJ for a festive atmosphere. Previous editions have featured food trucks, a DJ, smoke fireworks, as well as medals and drinks for participants.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly competitive and recreational race that has been held in Saltsjö-Duvnäs since 2007. The race is primarily intended for residents of Nacka, Värmdö and Saltsjöbaden, but welcomes other participants too. The start and finish are in Ringparken, and the race has strong local roots, with a focus on preserving its character as a family event for all ages. In 2027, the race celebrates 20 years with new start categories and continued community spirit among neighbours and runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ringparken in Saltsjö-Duvnäs
Courses of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km (the 10 km course is two laps of the 5 km course)
The course features varied terrain with hills, a waterfront promenade and views around Duvnäs Udde
additional: Timing chips are now integrated into the race bib. Race administration opens the day before and on race day. Participant numbers are limited to preserve the family atmosphere. The children’s race has its own short course around Ringparken.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park och Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a relay race for teams of 2–4 people, held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The course is approximately 5.4 km long and winds through areas including ESS and Kunskapsparken, on a mix of asphalt and gravel. The relay is part of Innovationsloppet & stafetten, where participants kick off autumn together with an energy boost in a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere. The races celebrate Lund as a city of innovation and are organised in partnership by IFK Lund Friidrott and Ideon Science Park.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km and runs from Nobelparken via ESS and Kunskapsparken
A mix of asphalt and gravel, with a flat course and approximately 10 metres of elevation difference
Views of northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams can be women's, men's or mixed teams of 2–4 people, and runners may run more than one leg. The start and finish are in Nobelparken in Brunnshög. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal or a sausage. The competition area is easily accessible by tram and bus. Teams compete in women's, men's or mixed categories. Each runner runs approximately 5 km.

name: Paltmilen
description: Paltmilen is a 10 km city race in central Piteå organised by Pite Runners. The course is flat and certified and runs along some of the town's most scenic stretches before finishing in the centre via Sweden's first pedestrian street. Start and finish are in Badhusparken, a stone's throw from the centre. 2026 was the second edition.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 10 km course
Finish via Sweden's first pedestrian street
Children's races of about 500 m and 1,500 m
additional: All finishers get a medal and something to drink. Prizes are drawn in the main race, and the top three women and men compete for prize money. Registration is through Jp7an Timing.

name: Umemilen
description: Umemilen is IFK Umeå's big autumn fun run. The race is certified and follows an easy 10 km loop around Lake Nydalasjön in Umeå. Younger runners can take part in Lilla Umemilen. Registration is via Race ID.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km loop around Nydalasjön
Easy, fast course
Lilla Umemilen for younger runners
additional: IFK Umeå publishes the race results on the club website.

name: Enköpingsloppet
description: Enköpingsloppet is an annual running festival in Enköping that brings together hundreds of runners from across Sweden. The event offers several distances for runners of all levels, from a children’s race to longer 10 km races, and is a celebration for the whole city. The courses are scenic and flat, with beautiful views of Enköping’s parks and waterfront areas. There is a group warm-up, music and cheering along the course, as well as post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: A scenic two-lap course around Drömparken (5.5 km)
A flat, scenic 10 km course through Enköping, officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association
A water station halfway along the 10 km course, with music and cheering along the way
additional: Group warm-up approximately 15 minutes before each race starts. Post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks for all runners. Results and finish times are available online immediately after finishing. The event area at ENA-vallen’s IP opens at 10:00. Start times: 11:00 Ajabaja Cancer Race (children’s race), 12:30 APC Race (5.5 km), 14:00 ICA Maxi Mile (10 km). Prize ceremonies take place after each race. The event area is located at ENA-vallen’s IP. The official website lists a different race date for 2027 than the stated date of 11 September.

name: Hogialoppet 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deltagaravgiften är 100 kronor per vuxen vid anmälan till klasserna DAM och HERR

description: Hogialoppet is a fun run in Stenungsund that focuses on the joy of movement and community. Participants can choose to run, jog or walk one of two distances, approximately 3.1 km or 6.5 km. Everyone is welcome, including children, dogs, and participants with strollers or walking poles. The event area offers activities and entertainment for the whole family on race day.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 6.5 km long and runs from Hogia, over Hallerna to Kyrkenorum, and back along Ucklumsvägen
A water station is available after approximately 3 km
The finish is in the event area, where participants are offered water and fruit
additional: The starting field is arranged so that participants with walking poles, dogs or strollers line up farther back to avoid congestion. Race bibs can be collected from 09:00. The event area is open 09:30–13:30 and offers a quiz walk with questions for both adults and children. Participants may bring a stroller, dog or walking poles. For the 2026 race, the adult entry fee is stated to go entirely to BRIS. Dogs, strollers and walking poles are allowed. The race has also included a shorter children's race.

name: Innovationsloppet
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott och Ideon Science Park
description: Innovationsloppet & the relay is a running event held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The event offers an individual 11 km distance or a relay with 4 legs of 5.5 km each. The course winds through areas such as ESS and Kunskapsparken, offering flat, varied terrain with asphalt and gravel. The event celebrates Lund as a city of innovation and is open to women’s, men’s and mixed relay teams, as well as individual runners. The start and finish are centrally located in Nobelparken, with good public transport connections by tram and bus.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km per lap, with two laps for individual runners
The terrain is flat, with approximately 10 metres of elevation difference, and consists of asphalt and gravel
Views over northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams consist of 2–4 people and can be women’s, men’s or mixed teams. Teams with fewer than 4 members must have runners complete more than one leg. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal and a sausage. The entry fee includes a place in the event, a bib with timing, and a medal or sausage after the finish. Participants choose a medal or sausage when registering.

name: Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen is a recurring running race on Ekerö that welcomes runners of all levels and the whole family. The event offers four different distances, from a children’s race for the youngest runners to the classic 10-kilometre main race. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on paved footpaths and park trails, with the start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Mälarömilen is organised by Mälarö SOK, and all proceeds go back to the club’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: Pleasant, runner-friendly courses on paved footpaths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground, in scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration is available on race day, subject to availability. There is a drinks station shortly after the start/lap point. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available in the KOM building at Träkvista sports ground. A first-aid tent is staffed throughout the event. All races start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Group registration is available for teams and companies.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running and recreational race organized by Lidköpings VSK since the late 1960s. The race takes place in Råda and offers classes and distances of up to 18 km. It is usually held on the second Saturday in September and is a welcome event for runners of all ages. The Paprikaloppet for children is often held on the same day in partnership with Ica Hjertbergs.
course_highlights: Run in scenic Råda
Classes and distances of up to 18 km
Traditionally held on the second Saturday in September
additional: Rådalunken is held together with the Paprikaloppet for children on the same day. The race offers classes and distances of up to 18 km. The event is part of Lidköpings VSK’s annual competition program. Previous editions have offered the Papricaloppet for younger children. Timing has been handled by C-time, and Umara sports drink has been served.

name: Brotorp Trailrun
location: Skogsluffarnas klubbstuga Brotorp, Bagarmossen, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Brotorp Trailrun is a challenging and enjoyable trail race on a technical 7 km loop through the finest parts of Nackareservatet. The race offers several distances, including a children’s course, 7 km, 14 km and 21 km, with the start and finish at Skogsluffarna’s clubhouse, Brotorp, in Bagarmossen. The courses feature varied terrain, with trails near lakes and hills, marked with orange ribbons and signs. There are aid stations along the course with water, sports drink and bananas, and after the finish, runners in the longer distances are served hamburgers. Timing is provided by Sportident, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Technical 7 km loop marked with orange ribbons and signs
The course passes through the finest parts of Nackareservatet, with lakes and hills
Aid stations every 3.5 km with water, sports drink and bananas
additional: The start and finish are at the Brotorp clubhouse. Bib collection takes place on race day, at least one hour before the start. Food and refreshments are available at the clubhouse. The time limit for the longest distance is 4 hours; everyone must finish before 14:00. Showers are available, but runners are encouraged to shower at home. The awards ceremony is planned for approximately 12:30. A discount code is available for children running 7 km (50% discount). According to the organizer, children who register for 7 km receive a 50 percent discount with the discount code “barnrabatt”.

name: Vildmarksmilen
description: Vildmarksmilen is a fun trail race through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Hemlingby outdoor recreation area in Gävle. The course is varied, with terrain that changes depending on the weather, making the race challenging but accessible to runners used to narrow trails and off-trail terrain. The start and finish are at Spårcentralen, and the race ends with a steep climb up the Hemlingbyberget ski slope. Vildmark15 is recommended for those looking for a greater challenge, but it is not being held in 2026 due to construction work.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails, roots, rocks and marshland
Water station at 5 km and at the finish
A final climb up the Hemlingbyberget ski slope before the finish
additional: Late registration is available on-site until 15 minutes before the start. Bib pickup, late registration, the start and the finish are at Hemlingby Spårcentral. Hemlingbystugan is currently closed, and no food or refreshments are available there. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and there are performance and raffle prizes. In 2026, an alternative course route was used due to construction work in the Hemlingby outdoor recreation area, and Vildmark 15 was not held.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
location: Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park, Linköping, Sweden
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively public relay in Collegium Park at Linköping Science Park. Teams consist of four people, and each runner covers approximately 3 kilometres. The race welcomes both elite teams and recreational groups, with plenty of colour and imagination along the course. After the finish, activities, food for sale, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw await.
course_highlights: Relay course of approximately 3 kilometres per runner
Four runners per team
Course in Collegium Park at Linköping Science Park
additional: According to the existing event information, the race starts at 17:00. After the race, activities, food for sale, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw will be held.

name: LöpRallarn
description: LöpRallarn is a running race organized by Bottnaryds IF at Bottnaryds IP. The race offers distances of 7.5 km and 15 km, on a course that includes loops through varied terrain. The event attracts both young people and adult runners and has a wonderful late-summer atmosphere, with energetic participants. The race has a tradition of bringing together a strong field and offers an enjoyable challenge for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 7.5 km and 15 km course options with two loops
Varied terrain and surfaces
Start and finish at Bottnaryds IP
additional: The race has two distances: 7.5 km and 15 km. In previous years, the race has had start groups and attracted over 100 participants. Results and contact details are available via christian.wigren@rallarloppet.se. Shorter distances of 1 and 2 km are also available. Bottnaryds IF’s pages list different dates for the 2027 race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bottnarydsif.se/bottnarydsif-rallarloppen-loprallarn): 2027-09-16 — "RallarLoppen 2027 16 sep" (was estimated 2027-09-05)

name: Kung Björn Loppet

price_tiers.distance: Mini Kung Björn (barn upp till 7 år)
Lilla Kung Björn (barn upp till 12 år)
10 km, 6 km och Trail ca 5 km

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälan sista veckan 345 kr för samtliga klasser

description: Kung Björn Loppet is a trail race in Uppsala that welcomes elite runners, recreational runners and children of all ages, with families at its heart. The race is held at OK Linné’s clubhouse and offers several distances, including a children’s race, 6 km, 10 km and a trail race of approximately 5 km. The courses consist of gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt, with water stations along the longer distances. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants.
course_highlights: Trail race on gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt
Courses of approximately 10 km and 6 km, plus a trail race of approximately 5 km
Two water stations on the 10 km course and one on the 6 km course
additional: Race bibs with electronic chips can be collected from Löplabbet the day before race day or on race day from 09:00. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the event site, but space is limited. A kiosk sells drinks, hot dogs and baked goods. Start groups are available for the 10 km, with a choice of faster and slower groups. Paid parking is available, but public transport and cycling are recommended. The event includes race-bib collection with electronic chips and an awards ceremony.

name: Kistaloppet
location: Jan Stenbecks torg, Kista, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Kistaloppet is a popular running event in Kista, Stockholm, offering races for the whole family, with distances ranging from 400 metres for the youngest participants to 5 km for adults. The race passes through Kista’s distinctive surroundings, including the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green spaces of Järvafältet and the IT cluster that has made Kista known as the Silicon Valley of Northern Europe. The event has a festive atmosphere, with music and entertainment along the course, and an inclusive spirit in which all participants receive a medal. Kistaloppet is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works to promote health and physical activity in suburban communities.
course_highlights: A 5 km measured course through Kista’s Million Programme neighbourhood and green spaces
Start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg, in central Kista
Entertainment and music stations along the course to keep participants motivated
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the event centre in Kista Galleria, in the premises opposite McDonald’s, on Friday 12:00–18:00 and Saturday 09:15–13:00. Late registration is available on site, subject to availability. There is a water station at the finish. Medical staff will be on site. All participants receive a specially designed medal. Music and DJs along the course create a festive atmosphere. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date or registration terms for 2027. The 2026 information also lists a 1.6 km untimed Fun Run and children’s races of approximately 1.6 km and 500 metres.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOK clubhouse Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an ultramarathon in Västerås with several distances, including 100 miles, 50 miles, Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a 10-mile (16.1 km) loop with varied surfaces, including technical trails, jogging paths, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt. Runners who complete 100 miles in under 24 hours receive a belt buckle, while all other finishers receive a medal. Runners can donate their medal in support of Doctors Without Borders.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: technical trails, jogging paths, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt
One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km)
Start, lap point and finish at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, with changing rooms, showers and a sauna
additional: If you run 100 miles in under 24 hours, you receive a belt buckle. Runners can opt to forgo their medal in support of Doctors Without Borders; 20 kr per medal is then donated to the organization. Showers and a sauna are also available in the clubhouse near the start/finish. Runners who complete 100 miles within 24 hours receive a belt buckle; all other finishers receive a medal.

name: Lergöksloppet
description: Lergöksloppet is a running race held on trails and forest roads in the beautiful Kronoskogen in Ängelholm, offering runners of all ages an inspiring setting close to nature. After the finish, participants in Class 1 are served fruit and squash, while those in the other classes can enjoy coffee or tea. The race welcomes runners of all ages and is known for its warm community spirit in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: The routes follow trails and forest roads
The race takes place in Kronoskogen in Ängelholm
A scenic, inspiring setting close to nature
additional: After the finish, participants in Class 1 are served fruit and squash; participants in the other classes are offered coffee or tea.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast and scenic half marathon on a gently descending, paved trail from Forshaga Learning Center to Karlstad. The course is completely traffic-free and has no steep climbs, providing ideal conditions for setting personal records. The race follows Klarälvsbanan through the Värmland countryside and offers a unique running experience on 90 kilometers of paved nature trail. There are three official refreshment stations along the course with water and sports drinks, and fruit and refreshments await at the finish. The race starts on Saturday at 10:30, with a group warm-up in the start area.
course_highlights: Gently descending paved trail from Forshaga to Karlstad
Completely traffic-free course with no steep climbs
Three official refreshment stations with water and sports drinks
additional: The start and race-bib distribution take place at Forshaga Learning Center from 09:00 to 10:00 on race day. Participants must finish within the time limit of 2:45. A minibus follows the field and picks up participants who do not meet the time limit. Buses run from Karlstad City Library to the start for those who have purchased bus transport. Fruit and refreshments are available at the finish. On-site payments are accepted only by card or Swish. Medical assistance is available at the start, finish, and refreshment stations. The organizer describes the race as a possible “Scandinavia’s fastest half marathon?”.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail is a trail race through central Trollhättan that began in 2016. Starting at Folkets Park, the race takes runners through varied terrain featuring urban surroundings, hilly trails, stairs, and scenic areas such as Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, several locks, Olidan, and Kungsgrottan. There are several distances to choose from, from a short, child-friendly Mini Trail to longer, challenging courses of up to 22.5 km. The race also offers starting categories for running with a dog on certain distances, making it an inclusive event with a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Trail race with hilly paths and challenging stairs
Passes several locks, Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, Olidan, and Kungsgrottan
A mix of urban surroundings and nature experiences
additional: Bib collection opens at 11:30. Start times: 13:00 for the Mini Trail 0.8 km; 14:00 for the City Trail 8.5, 14, and 22.5 km; and 14:15 for the City Trail 8.5 and 14 km with a dog on a leash. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 30 minutes after the first finisher. The race offers separate starting groups for running with a dog on a leash in the 8.5 km and 14 km races. The Mini Trail is a children’s race without timing or competition for ages 0–12. Start and finish are at Folkets Park. Previous editions have offered 8.5 km, 14 km, and 22.5 km, as well as the Trollhättan Mini Trail of approximately 0.8 km.

name: Hökensås Trail
location: First Camp Hökensås, Tidaholm Municipality, Sweden
description: Hökensås Trail is a trail race starting at First Camp Hökensås, where pine heath and rolling ridges create a nature-close running experience. Choose from distances of 5.5 km, 11.5 km and 19 km. The race is suitable both for those who want to try trail running and for those seeking a longer challenge in a forest setting.
course_highlights: Run across the pine heath and rolling ridges of Hökensås.
Three distances: 5.5 km, 11.5 km and 19 km.
Start and finish at First Camp Hökensås.

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet is a traditional cross-country race dating back to 1966, organised by IFK Skövde Skidor. The race has historically featured varying distances, but since 1993 both men and women have competed over 10.5 km. There are also categories for younger participants, such as Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet, as well as a Nordic walking category for recreational participants. The race has attracted many well-known Swedish runners over the years and is a popular event in Skövde.
course_highlights: A cross-country race with a long tradition dating back to 1966
A 10.5 km race for both men and women since 1993
Categories for young runners and Nordic walking
additional: There are categories for younger participants, including Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet. There is also a Nordic walking category for those who prefer it. Course records are documented for men and women over 10.5 km, as well as for older distances.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping, with Trädgårdsföreningen as its meeting place. Runners can come together for a day of exercise and the joy of running in a welcoming setting. The race is organized by Linköpings GIF, and registration for the 2026 edition is open.
course_highlights: Trädgårdsföreningen is the race’s meeting place.
The race takes place in Linköping.
Details of the course route are not available in the sources provided.
additional: Members of Linköpings GIF can participate for free in all categories with the campaign code LGIF2026.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is Nacka’s big autumn running festival, with races for all ages and abilities. The main event is a 10 km recreational race along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energiloppet, Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old, and Mini Sickla for the youngest runners. The races offer a scenic, fast course, a great atmosphere, and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a public health event for Nacka and Stockholm.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of asphalt, gravel, and a wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with spectators and musical entertainment
additional: The race venue opens at 08:00 at Marcusplatsen in Sickla Köpkvarter, with race-number pickup and on-site registration. Food trucks and partners will be on site. Lilla Sicklaloppet starts at times between 09:15 and 10:15 for different age groups. Sicklaloppet 5 km starts at 11:45, and the 10 km starts at 13:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour and 15 minutes, with a cut-off at Kyrkviken after approximately 7.5 km. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation. All races start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter. The race website describes the 2026 edition.

name: Kraftloppet
description: Kraftloppet is a relay race in Finspång with seven legs totalling about 31 kilometres. All legs start and finish at Grosvads IP, Arena Grosvad, and the race runs through scenic countryside in Finspång municipality. There are legs to suit everyone regardless of age or running form. The main organiser is Finspångs AIK Friidrott. The 2026 edition was held on Sunday 20 September with the start at 11:00.
course_highlights: Seven legs totalling about 31 km
Start and finish for every leg at Grosvads IP, Arena Grosvad
Classes for women's, men's and mixed teams
additional: A team has at least four different runners and one runner may run at most two legs. Mixed teams need at least two women. In 2026 the entry fee was 1,000 SEK per team (1,500 SEK after 12 September) and registration was through AnmälMigNu.

name: Lindholmenstafetten
description: Lindholmenstafetten is a relay race at Lindholmen in Gothenburg, organised by Ullevi Friidrott as part of Lindholmen Open Day. Teams have four runners who each run 2.5 km, 10 km in total. Start and finish are at Vassen, Pumpgatan 10. The 2026 edition was held on Thursday 24 September at 18:00 with classes for women, men and mixed teams.
course_highlights: 4 x 2.5 km relay at Lindholmen
Start and finish at Vassen, Pumpgatan 10
Prize for the company entering the most teams
additional: In 2026 a team cost 1,595 SEK until 30 June and 1,795 SEK after that, with a 20 percent discount for five or more teams. The entry included a goodie bag. After the finish there was an After Run at Vassen with light food and drinks.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4 km, 1.7 km
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and a much-loved running challenge held annually on Lidingö since 1965. More than 30,000 runners gather during race weekend to run scenic, hilly courses, from short children’s races to the classic 30 km race, a true test of endurance. The race is a world-class celebration of running and a showcase for the joy of movement and public health, with nature always at its heart. Participants can also enjoy a sports expo featuring partners and exhibitors offering inspiration ahead of the race.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course featuring flat meadows, gravel roads and steep climbs
The 30 km race has 522 metres of elevation gain and is open for training around the clock before race day
Aid stations along the course offering sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas
additional: The sports expo at Lidingövallen takes place during race weekend, where participants collect their race bibs and can browse offers and expert advice. Free buses run between Ropsten and Lidingövallen during race weekend. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Photographers are stationed along the course and at the finish, with photos available to purchase after the race. The course profile and elevation gains are presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ feature for pace planning. Aid stations offer sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas. Lidingöloppet encourages environmentally friendly travel by public transport, bicycle or carpooling. Lidingöloppet weekend includes races for different ages and levels, from a 1.7 km children’s race.

name: Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: Gudö Run of Hope
description: Gudö Run of Hope is a beautiful trail race in Tyresö, held in support of the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities to run, walk or jog. Participants can choose from several distances, from 1 km to 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk. The event is part of the fight against childhood cancer and offers a meaningful and enjoyable experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A beautiful trail race in Tyresö
Several distances: 1 km, 3 km, 6 km, 10 km and a 5 km walk
Suitable for runners of all ages, big and small
additional: The race is organised by Gudö Sportklubb in Tyresö. Participants can run, walk or jog. The event encourages donations via Swish and QR code for those who cannot participate. The Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund is the organiser, and the contact persons can be reached via the email address provided. Proceeds go to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet 250 kr till och med 26/9 2027

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: Ekerumsloppet
location: Ekerum Resort, Borgholm Municipality, Öland, Sweden
description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, an autumn trail race on Öland, starting and finishing at Ekerum Resort. The 10-kilometre course follows forest trails around Ekerum and Rällaskogen, and young runners can take part in a course of approximately 1.3 kilometres. A pleasant opportunity to experience Öland’s natural surroundings in your running shoes.
course_highlights: Trail running on forest paths
Course around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
additional: 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for young runners. According to the existing information, the start times are 11:00 and 10:00, respectively.

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon is a recreational running event held in Tidaholm, offering both recreational and competitive races, individually and as a relay. The race is part of Motionsloppet.se’s series of events and also includes the Swedish Half Marathon Championships. It is a welcoming event for runners of different levels, organized by Cykelklubben U6 and Grebbestad Multisport.
course_highlights: Running in and around Tidaholm
Individual race and relay option
Includes the Swedish Half Marathon Championships
additional: Umara is the sports drink supplier at the events.

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025
location: Rya Åsar Nature Reserve, Borås, Sweden
description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a popular trail race in Borås, offering beautiful and varied terrain in the Rya Åsar Nature Reserve. The race has several distances to suit both beginners and experienced trail runners, with challenging hills and lovely views. The start and finish area has a great atmosphere, with music, exhibitors, food and a runners’ lounge. The event has a family-friendly feel, with children’s races and a festival atmosphere in the forest that attracts many participants every year.
course_highlights: Varied trail running on beautiful paths with challenging hills
Djävulsbacken—a 300 m-long hill with 75 m of elevation gain
Beautiful views at Rya Klint, Fjällsjön and Hestrastugan
additional: Start and finish on the plateau at Rya Åsar, with music, exhibitors, a runners’ lounge and food service. Bib collection on Friday and Saturday. Chip timing, with start groups for elite, fast runners and recreational runners. Bag drop available. Toilets, changing facilities and showers at Borås Camping. Aid stations with Umara sports drink on the 24 km and 12 km courses. Children’s races of 800 m and 1.8 km are available. Children’s races and sanctioned competitions are offered.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organised by Motala AIF Friidrott, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a renewed old course that runs through central parts of Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km race having a separate lane for lapping on the first lap. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to give runners the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, centrally located in Motala
Renewed old course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration takes place on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Race bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on Friday 2/10 from 10:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 3/10 from 10:00 to 12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop is by the stage.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an autumn event organized by Dalaportens OL in Avesta. The race offers an exciting running experience in scenic surroundings and is part of Dalaportens orienteering activities. Participants can register via MittLopp and enjoy a well-organized event with good service. Together with Backyard Ultra, it creates a unique running weekend in October.
course_highlights: Running in scenic surroundings around Avesta
Part of Dalaportens OL’s autumn event
Backyard Ultra with 6.7 km laps and a mass start every hour
additional: Backyard Ultra starts at 11:00 on October 3, on a 6.7 km course that is mostly on a shared walking and cycling path. A new lap starts every hour, with a mass start, and the competition continues until only one participant remains. A refreshment station with drinks and energy supplies is available at the lap point. Registration for Backyard Ultra is by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, with an entry fee of 350 kr. Maximum 80 participants. Previous editions have been held together with Avesta Backyard Ultra.

name: Dalsland X-Trail
distance_verbose: 22 km, 13 km, 9 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: Dalsland X-Trail is a trail race on forest paths around Bengtsfors, organised by Camp Dalsland. There are three running distances, 9 km, 13 km and 22 km, where the 22 km runs one lap of the 13 km course and one of the 9 km course, plus a 13 km hiking class. Start and finish are at Långevi sports ground in Bengtsfors. The next edition is on Saturday 2 October 2027.
course_highlights: 22 km Utmaningen: one lap of 13 km plus one of 9 km
13 km hiking class with detours to viewpoints
Free Mini-DXT kids' races over 500 m, 1 km and 1.5 km
additional: Start times: 13 km and 22 km at 11:30, 9 km at 12:00, the hike at 09:30 and the kids' races at about 11:00. Bibs are collected from 09:00 at Camp Dalsland's check-in tent and late entry is possible on site 09:30-11:00. There are drink stations on the courses and changing rooms with showers at the start/finish. Everyone who finishes gets a medal.

name: Avesta Backyard Ultra
description: Avesta Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultra in Avesta organised by the orienteering club Dalaportens OL. The 6,706 metre lap runs mostly on walking and cycle paths from the Åsbo outdoor area, with start and finish at Slalombacken Åsbo. A new lap starts with a joint start every full hour and the race goes on until only one runner is left. The 2026 edition was held on Saturday 3 October with the start at 11:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km lap with a joint start every full hour
Start and finish at Slalombacken Åsbo
Results available from every edition since 2018
additional: A well-stocked depot with drinks and energy is at the lap change, but there is no drink station out on the lap. Everyone who completes at least one lap gets a final result. In 2026 entry was by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, the fee was 350 SEK and the field was capped at 80.

name: Hiit Out Trailrun 12 km
description: HIIT OUT Trailrun is a trail race offering varied terrain with forest, trails, elevation changes and technical sections in Mellingerum, Oskarshamn. The race focuses not only on finishing time but also on the experience along the way, with a challenge, the joy of running and a wonderful experience in nature. The 12 km distance is one of several course options, suitable for both experienced trail runners and beginners aged 15 and over. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with dedicated volunteers and spectators.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest and trails
Elevation changes and technical sections
A nature-rich experience along the trails
additional: Everyone aged 15 and over is welcome to take part. The race is organised with a focus on the experience and the joy of running, not just race time. Results from previous years show participation in the 8 km, 12 km and 16 km distances. A medal is awarded at the finish.

name: Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with climbs of 300, 600 and 1,500 metres respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance involving five ascents of the mountain. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and tough trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails through pristine wilderness
Beautiful views of small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children's race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Bib transfers are possible under the terms on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, as well as VMX Kids. Trail-running shoes are recommended.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund to TanumStrand, Tanum Municipality, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a 22 km trail race from Havstenssund to TanumStrand and the final race in the Outnorth Trailtour. The race offers a scenic course with cliffs, jetties, the scent of seaweed and views that soothe the mind while the body works hard. Sweden’s trail-running elite gather here for exciting races in a unique setting where mountains, forest and sea meet. Participants can also extend the experience with accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.
course_highlights: 22 km of trail running from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Scenic views featuring cliffs, jetties and the scent of seaweed
Part of the Outnorth Trailtour, featuring Sweden’s trail-running elite
additional: Accommodation and a banquet are offered at TanumStrand Spa & Resort to round out the weekend. Subscribers get access to a newsletter with current information and offers, including 20% off Asics trail shoes at Outnorth. The organizer’s text recommends accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a running event held at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. The race offers a challenging 25 km course for both women and men, where participants can experience beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Skrylle area. The event brings together runners from different clubs and towns, creating a sense of community and competition. Skrylle Challenge is a popular race for both experienced runners and enthusiasts looking to test their endurance in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: 25 km of running on varied terrain
Scenic views in the Skrylle area
A challenging course for both women and men
additional: Participant lists show separate bib numbers and clubs for women and men in the 25 km class.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race organised by Ryssbergets IK in Bromölla, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is clearly marked with arrows, lines and tape, and marshals are on hand to show the way. Participants can expect water stations serving water and sports drink, as well as a friendly atmosphere with coffee and grilled sausages served after the race. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and medical staff are available in the start and finish area. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and results and to the use of photographs and videos from the event.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations serving water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. The prize ceremony begins at 12:30. Registration is primarily by advance entry, but on-site registration is also available. The event follows the Swedish Athletics Association’s rules for road races. The race information states that prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category. Race numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date 9 October 2027.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race takes place at the Swedish Maritime Museum in Stockholm and offers an easy-to-run 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. All participants contribute to psychiatric research, as all proceeds go directly to this cause. Mental Health Run welcomes everyone, regardless of background or fitness level, and promotes community and the joy of movement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Maritime Museum
Easy-to-run/walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course through the scenic surroundings of Djurgården
additional: A medal can be selected as an optional extra when registering. The dog race is a special event where participants run or walk together with their dog, which must be kept on a leash throughout the race. The dog race focuses on the joy of movement and community rather than performance. Participation is at your own risk, and dog owners are responsible for their dogs. Participants in the dog race start at the back of the field. There is also a virtual race from 10–31 October 2027. A medal is included for in-person participants. The deadline to register for the in-person race is 8 October 2027 at 12:00.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a traditional race being held for the 52nd time, offering both a marathon and a half marathon. The course is flat and straight, with the start and finish at the historic Slottsskogsvallen in Göteborg. It follows an out-and-back route along the old coastal railway embankment, with beautiful views of the sea and archipelago. The race is well organised, with aid stations every four kilometres and a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all levels. It is a perfect race for anyone looking to run fast and enjoy a scenic course near the sea.
course_highlights: Flat, straight course along the old coastal railway embankment
Turnaround at the Lilla Amundön boat-storage area after approximately 10.5 km
Aid stations every four kilometres with water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins
additional: The start and finish are inside Slottsskogsvallen. Marathon start group 1 starts at 10:00. Half-marathon start group 2 (target finish under 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:30, and half-marathon start group 3 (target finish over 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:45. After finishing, participants are offered a drink and a sandwich. Participants may have their own drinks and energy products transported to the aid stations. Race bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. The event offers a marathon and a half marathon. The course was officially measured in 2024.

name: Umemaran
organizer: Jalles TC Umeå och IFK Umeå
description: Umemaran is a running festival that brings runners together in Umeå and is organized by Jalles TC together with IFK Umeå. The event offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a fast, scenic course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides. It has been a tradition since 1973 and also serves as the Northern Norrland Championships for the marathon. Participants are offered refreshments every four kilometres, a medal at the finish, and coffee and a sandwich after the race.
course_highlights: A fast course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides
Every kilometre is marked, and the course has been officially measured by an SFIF certified course measurer
Refreshment stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every four kilometres
additional: Slow runners with finish times of 4:45 or longer may start at 10:00 after registering in advance. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jubileumshallen near the start area. Bibs and chips must be collected no later than 45 minutes before the start at Tegs Centralskola, with collection also available the day before at Team Sportia Ersboda. The prize ceremony takes place immediately after the 21 km race and at approximately 16:20 for the 42 km race in the auditorium at Tegs Centralskola. Everyone who completes the 42 km race has a chance to win a bicycle in a draw at the prize ceremony. The marathon is the Northern Norrland Championships for seniors and veterans.

name: Tjurruset
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun trail race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 kilometres. The race features muddy sections, trail paths and wet conditions, and is perfect for anyone who doesn’t mind getting dirty and wants a different kind of running experience. Showers and rinse-off facilities are available after the race, and the event is marked by a spirit of community where determination matters more than running technique. Tjurruset is organised by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Terrain with muddy sections and wet conditions
Trail paths in Norra Djurgården
Challenging forest terrain with natural obstacles
additional: Warm showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinse-off facilities right after finishing. There are collection points for clothes that cannot be taken home. Shoes with good grip and clothes you don’t mind getting dirty are strongly recommended, as the mud can suck a shoe off mid-stride. Companies and larger groups can arrange a joint registration and book a company tent.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
description: Running Lights is a magical running event held during the famous Lights in Alingsås festival. The race offers distances for all ages and levels, from the Knatteloppet for the youngest runners to 10 km for more experienced runners. Enjoy a running celebration amid magical lighting, through beautifully illuminated areas in central Alingsås. Running Lights is also part of the Västsvenska löparcupen, offering extra competition opportunities for club runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Routes through beautifully illuminated areas during Lights in Alingsås
Distances from 300 m to 10 km, with varied loops around squares and parks
additional: Start times by distance: Maxi-Knatte 300m at 16:00, Energiloppet 600m at 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 1660m at 16:45, Stafetten 3 x 1660m at 17:05, 5 km at 18:00, 10 km at 19:00. The routes are loops around Stora torget, the river, the squares and Museiparken. The relay is for teams of 3 people, each running one lap. Bib pickup and the running expo are held at Estrad, Bryggerigatan 2. The race is part of the Västsvenska Långloppscupen and Västsvenska löparcupen.

name: Borgen Outdoor Run
description: Borgen Outdoor Run is a challenging trail race held in the Alandsryd area at Friluftsgården Borgen in Värnamo. The race offers a fun and varied course featuring a ski slope and forest trails, giving participants a wonderful experience in nature. The event is well established and attracts runners who appreciate both a challenge and a sense of community in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Alandsryd area
Route through the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope, with elevation changes
Scenic and varied course with forest trails
additional: Groundwork is underway at the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope (between 2–3 km) to increase the vertical drop, which may result in minor course adjustments in that area. According to the event information, the race is open to all ages, and participants can run individually or as part of a pre-registered team.

name: Terräng DM
description: Welcome to the District Championships in cross-country running, held at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School. The race features a course that is mostly on grass, with a short 70-metre hill on asphalt. Runners in different age groups and masters categories can take part over a range of distances. Bib numbers and check-in are at the race office by the start area.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on grass
A 70-metre hill on asphalt
Start and finish at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School
additional: Check-in and bib numbers are at the race office beside the start. The events include youth and masters categories. Check-in and bib numbers are collected at the race office next to the start.

name: Gränbyloppet
price_range: 100–200 kr för icke-medlemmar (2026 års priser); gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott
description: Gränbyloppet is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott and takes over from Ultunamilen, with a focus on the joy of running in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for youth and adults. The start and finish are at the intersection just northeast of the pergola in the middle of Gränbyparken, near IFU Arena. The race is open to both members and non-members, with a simple and clear online registration process.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with a blue 2.5 km loop
The race is held in conjunction with the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a clearly visible race bib. The start and finish are approximately 800 metres from IFU Arena. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held in conjunction with Gränbyloppet for youth aged 14 and under. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien, whose final day is aimed at youth aged 14 and under. Information about distances and fees applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
location: Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100, Hässelby, Stockholm, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwestern Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day also features Lilla Hässelbyloppet, a children’s and youth race with shorter distances and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The start and finish are at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through northwestern Stockholm
Start and finish at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro
Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people, with timing for participants aged 9 and over
additional: Pacers are available from 37:30 to 60 minutes. Bib pickup opens the day before the race. Lilla Hässelbyloppet offers timing for participants aged 9 and over, and refreshments and snacks after the finish. Hässelbyloppet starts in a large field about 400 metres from Hässelby Idrottsplats. Lilla Hässelbyloppet has bibs and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The start and finish are at Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100. The official website lists 3 October 2027 as the date of Hässelbyloppet.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run is a unique trail race in Sollentuna, focused on the experience of darkness and nature. The race offers several distances, including a challenging 30 km course where runners navigate using GPS and a map. The start and finish are at Väsby gård, and the course is marked with reflectors to create a magical atmosphere in the glow of headlamps. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with special rules for younger participants on the shorter distances.
course_highlights: Course marked with clear reflectors for a night-running experience
Navigation using GPS and a map on the 21 km and 30 km distances
Start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 for the 5 km and 10 km. The 21 km and 30 km start on Saturday, October 17, at 16:45 and 16:00, respectively. Minimum age is 18, but participants aged 15–18 may run the 5 km and 10 km if accompanied by an adult. A good headlamp is recommended, preferably with an extra lamp for the 30 km. The time limit for the 30 km is 4 hours and 30 minutes. Aid stations are available along the 21 km and 30 km courses. Previous organizer information states an age limit of 18 and a 4-hour-and-30-minute time limit for the 30 km.

name: Stockholm Cross Country
description: Stockholm Cross Country is a cross-country race in Stockholm organized by Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb. The race offers challenging distances in scenic surroundings on Gärdet, with courses of 2.5 km and 5 km. It is a popular race for both recreational runners and competitive runners looking to test their cross-country ability in a beautiful setting close to the city. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic surroundings on Gärdet in Stockholm
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Organized by Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is for those who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on experiencing nature as on performance. The event is held and offers a memorable course in hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event offering a wonderful day at Hellasgården, close to the city. The races pass through the beautiful Hellas area, by lakes and hills, along lovely running trails and roads. There are races for all ages, from the very youngest children, who can run 100 metres without registering in advance, to children aged 5–8 on a flat course. The day offers the joy of running, uphill sections, music and a lovely autumn setting, with refreshments and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Races through the Hellas area, with lakes and hills
Lovely running trails and roads
Flat course for children aged 5–8
additional: The first race starts at 10:00, and the final start for the 10 km race is expected around 12:00. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize ceremonies take place throughout the day. Athletics activities are available on site, with stations where you can try running, throwing and jumping. All children born in 2022 or later can run 100 m without registering in advance and will receive a medal. Refreshments are available throughout the day. The first race starts at 10:00, and the 10 km race is expected to start around 12:00. The 100-metre race for the youngest children does not require advance registration. Parking is available, and refreshments are served.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Växjö Marathon is a fast, flat marathon course consisting of eight laps around the beautiful Växjö Lake. The course is mostly paved, with a short section of fine gravel, and has very little elevation gain—about 3 meters per lap. The event welcomes both experienced runners and beginners, and also offers a relay race for teams. This is the 32nd edition of the race, which is known as Sweden’s fastest marathon course. The course is marked and has a lead cyclist and course marshals, but it is not closed to traffic during the race.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjö Lake
Flat, fast course with about 3 m of elevation gain per lap
Mostly paved surface, with about 300 meters of fine gravel
additional: The course is marked, and there is a lead cyclist and course marshals. Relay races are also available for teams. A children’s race is held as well. Sports drinks, dietary supplements, and energy and protein bars are available. The organizer is Växjö Running Club. The marathon relay has teams of four, with each runner completing two laps. The course is not closed to pedestrians, cyclists, or motor traffic.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a challenging trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne. Participants can choose from four distances: 2.5 km, 6 km, 11 km and 17 km, as well as an untimed children’s race. The courses feature gently rolling terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, hills and running on sand by the sea, providing a unique running experience. The race is part of Skåne Trailcup and also offers a team competition with great prizes. The event is open to everyone and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Gently rolling terrain with varied surfaces
A mix of trails, sand dunes and challenging hills
Running on sand along the sea
additional: Participant limit: 1,000. The children’s race is approximately 350 m long, has individual starts and is free to enter. Start times: 2.5 km and 6 km start at 12:30, 11 km and 17 km start at 12:40, and the children’s race has individual starts between 13:00 and 15:00. The time limit for the 17 km race is 2 hours and 50 minutes. Parking is limited; follow the instructions of event staff. Valuables storage is available for a fee of 20 SEK. Toilets are 200 metres from the event venue. The venue at Strandridaregården is approximately 100 metres from the sea. The children’s race is approximately 350 metres and is untimed. Prices are reported for the 2026 edition.

name: Varberg Halvmarathon
description:
Welcome to Varberg Half Marathon on Saturday, October 16, 2027—the big running event of the autumn! 21.1 km and 11.5 km.

The course takes you through much of Varberg. You’ll run along the beach in Apelviken and up on Hästhagaberget, with magnificent views of the sea. The route also passes through several parks and urban forests, including the beautiful Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen.
additional: All information and registration: https://varberghalvmarathon.se

images.alt_text: Löpare i startfältet för Varberg Halvmarathon i skogsmiljö under dagtid
Löpare vid kusten under Varberg Halvmarathon, glada och energiska på stigen.
Fyra löpare med Varberg Halvmarathon nummerlappar och medaljer efter loppet utomhus på gräs.
Löpare vid en vätskestation med bullar och drycker under ett utomhusevenemang.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a race for everyone, from elite runners to recreational runners, offering a completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association and is eligible for seeding at many races in Sweden and internationally. The race offers a great atmosphere, pacers for different finishing times, and the opportunity to take part in team competitions with friends. It’s a perfect chance to set a personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run with colleagues or friends.
course_highlights: A completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping
The 5K runs one lap; the 10K runs two laps
A water station with UMARA sports drink along the course
additional: Pacers carrying flags for 40-, 45- and 50-minute times in the 10K. Team competition with a 10% discount when registering with two friends. Warm-up with Fitness24Seven at 10:40 in the start/finish area. Limited bag drop in the start area in the morning. Parking is available in nearby parking garages for a fee. Register three people as a team for a 10% discount on the entry fee and a chance to win prizes. Up to five runners can be registered at the same time.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run Hundtrail is a unique evening race in Sollentuna where you can run with your dog over 5 or 10 kilometres. The courses are marked with reflectors, and headlamps are mandatory to create a magical nighttime experience. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, but young people aged 15 to 18 may participate if accompanied by an adult. It is an unforgettable evening enjoyed by both two- and four-legged participants.
course_highlights: The courses are marked with reflectors
Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (until 19:00 for 10 km)
Headlamps are mandatory, and dogs must be kept on a leash
additional: A maximum of one dog per runner. Age limit: 18; participants aged 15–18 may take part accompanied by an adult. Dogs must be kept on a leash and be comfortable around other dogs and people. The race takes place in the dark, with narrow passages and frequent encounters with other dogs, so reactive dogs are not recommended. One dog per runner; dogs must be kept on a leash. Flexible start times: 18:00–19:30 for 5 km and 18:00–19:00 for 10 km. Age limit: 18; young people aged 15 and over may participate with a responsible adult.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholm’s Steepest is an intense, energetic race that challenges you to run both up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken. The course is just over 3 km long and includes three climbs, taking you up two different ski slopes. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to test their lactic acid threshold and mental toughness. The finish is at the top of Hammarbybacken, with a fantastic view of Stockholm as the backdrop.
course_highlights: Just over 3 km with three climbs
Up two different ski slopes
Finish at the top of Hammarbybacken with views of Stockholm
additional: Bib collection takes place at the Hammarby Fabriksväg event area from 09:30 on race day. Bibs are personal and must be worn on the chest using safety pins. There are hydration stations along the course. For the relay, teams complete a total of 8 laps of approximately 1 km each, with 2–4 people per team. Children’s races are available for ages 7–12 (approximately 500 m) and ages 0–6 (approximately 300 m; registration via Skistar). The event area is easy to reach by public transport, and parking is limited. The relay covers approximately 8 km for teams of 2–4 people. Brantaste Mini is approximately 500 metres for children aged 7–12, and Valle’s Friends’ Race is approximately 300 metres for children aged 0–6. The start and finish are at Hammarbybacken; the organiser recommends public transport because there is no parking at the hill.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 75 kr

description: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026 is a unique running event celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race consists of a 6,706-metre loop starting at Bubblan in Toredal and running on asphalt and gravel. Participants run as many loops as they can manage over twelve hours, with a start every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. To continue, runners must complete each loop in under an hour, and the most enduring runner who is fastest on the final loop wins. There are women’s and men’s categories, as well as a MiniBackyard for children and young people who want to run shorter distances.
course_highlights: The loop is 6,706 metres long, with approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel
The course includes several longer climbs, including towards Sandbäcksvägen and the promenade
Start and finish at Bubblan in Toredal, with a final flat asphalt stretch leading to the grass field
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00, with up to 12 loops over twelve hours. Runners must complete each loop in under an hour to continue. MiniBackyard starts at 14:00 and lasts for a maximum of 45 minutes. Registration for MiniBackyard takes place on site. Coffee and refreshments are served at 20:00 after the final loop. The first start is at 09:00 and the last start is at 20:00. There is also a MiniBackyard with a loop of at least 670 metres; on-site registration costs 75 kr.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet makes a comeback in 2026 with a new, city-adjacent course that mainly follows walking and cycling paths through several of Skövde’s residential areas. Race day is October 18, and the races are designed as easy-to-run urban courses suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Three distances are offered (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km), with a shared start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.

name: Älvsjöloppet night trail
location: Gamla Älvsjö IP, Älvsjö, Stockholm, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr; gratis för medlemmar i OK Älvsjö-Örby
description: Älvsjöloppet Night Trail is an exciting 5 km evening race over hilly terrain in Älvsjöskogen, with 150 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at Gamla Älvsjö IP, about a 15-minute walk from Älvsjö station. The course is marked with reflective markers and requires a bright headlamp, preferably at least 1000 lumens, as well as good trail shoes to handle the terrain. After finishing, all runners are treated to sausages and drinks in a friendly atmosphere. The race is organised by OK Älvsjö Örby and is open to everyone, with free entry for club members.
course_highlights: 5 km reflective-marked course over hilly terrain with 150 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at Gamla Älvsjö IP, near Älvsjö station
Requires a bright headlamp and trail shoes with good grip
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are handed out from 18.15 to 18.45. The chip must be returned at the finish. Toilets and changing rooms are available on site. Parking is available in the area and at Herr Stens väg 2, but walking, cycling or running to the start is recommended. Live results and the results list are available at alvsjoloppet.se. After finishing, all runners are treated to sausages and drinks; no other refreshments are available. For 2026, a headlamp of at least 1000 lumens and trail shoes, preferably with metal studs, are recommended.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is one of Östergötland’s most unique and challenging running races, held at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope in Yxbacken, Norrköping. The race challenges participants with five laps up a hill with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres, for a total distance of approximately 7 kilometres. Whether you run fast or take it easy, everyone is welcome to take part, and the most important thing is to make it to the top. New this year is also a relay, adding an extra dimension to the race. Children can take part for free in the Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C, making it a family-friendly running festival.
course_highlights: Five laps up Yxbacken, with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres per lap
Approximately 7 kilometres in a unique race setting in Östergötland
Start at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 18:00, or at the start and finish area no later than one hour before the start. The bib includes a timing chip, which must be used to record your time. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal sponsored by Energi & Inneklimat.
